title: Uk i Hasanović ostaju u Vladi KS, Hota-Muminović odlazi
Uk and Hasanović stay in the Sarajevo Canton government, Hota-Muminović leaves
body: U utorak u 16 sati istekao je rok u kojem su izabrani zvaničnici morali reći da li prihvataju mandat.
On Tuesday at 4 p.m. the deadline expired by which elected officials had to say whether they accept their mandate.
Zato je sada jasnije ko ostaje u Vladi Kantona Sarajevo, a ko odlazi u Skupštinu KS.
That is why it is now clearer who stays in the Sarajevo Canton government and who goes to the Canton Assembly.
Premijer Nihad Uk i ministar zdravstva Enis Hasanović ostaju u Vladi dok se ne formira nova.
Prime Minister Nihad Uk and Health Minister Enis Hasanović stay in the government until a new one is formed.
Uk je prihvatio mandat u Predstavničkom domu Parlamenta FBiH, ali ga je zamrznuo.
Uk accepted a mandate in the House of Representatives of the FBiH Parliament, but he froze it.
Hasanović je izabran u Skupštinu KS, a i on je stavio mandat na čekanje.
Hasanović was elected to the Canton Assembly, and he also put his mandate on hold.
Rekao je da će ostati ministar dok se ne formira nova vlada i da se nada da će to biti uskoro.
He said that he will remain minister until a new government is formed and that he hopes it will be soon.
Ministrica obrazovanja Naida Hota-Muminović odmah napušta Vladu i prelazi u Skupštinu.
Education Minister Naida Hota-Muminović is leaving the government right away and moving to the Assembly.
Na Facebooku je napisala da je bila ministrica skoro 6 godina.
On Facebook she wrote that she had been minister for almost 6 years.
Ministar kulture i sporta Kenan Magoda ranije je u utorak također prihvatio mandat u Skupštini.
Culture and Sports Minister Kenan Magoda also accepted a mandate in the Assembly earlier on Tuesday.
Ministar saobraćaja Adnan Šteta odlučio je da ne preuzme mjesto u Skupštini.
Transport Minister Adnan Šteta decided not to take his seat in the Assembly.
Vlada KS je u tehničkom mandatu od februara, nakon što je Uk podnio ostavku zbog nesreće tramvaja.
The Canton government has been in a caretaker mandate since February, after Uk resigned because of a tram accident.
Vlada ima 13 članova i može odlučivati ako na sjednici bude najmanje 7.
The government has 13 members and can make decisions if at least 7 are at the session.

title: Vukanović: Dodik je Stanivukoviću ponudio tri ministarstva
Vukanović: Dodik offered Stanivuković three ministries
body: Nebojša Vukanović tvrdi da je Milorad Dodik ponudio Drašku Stanivukoviću tri ministarstva u Vladi Republike Srpske.
Nebojša Vukanović claims that Milorad Dodik offered Draško Stanivuković three ministries in the Government of Republika Srpska.
Prema njegovim informacijama, PSS bi dobio ministarstva energetike, poljoprivrede i sporta.
According to his information, PSS would get the ministries of energy, agriculture and sport.
Uz to, stranci bi pripale i niže funkcije u vlasti.
In addition, the party would also get lower positions in government.
Sastanak delegacija SNSD-a, SDS-a i PSS-a bio je zakazan za utorak u 16:30, ali nije održan.
A meeting of the SNSD, SDS and PSS delegations was scheduled for Tuesday at 16:30, but it did not take place.
SDS je u 12:35 poslao pismo u ime predsjednika stranke Branka Blanuše.
At 12:35 SDS sent a letter on behalf of party president Branko Blanuša.
U pismu piše da delegacija iz objektivnih razloga ne može doći u dogovoreno vrijeme.
The letter says that the delegation cannot come at the agreed time for objective reasons.
SDS je predložio sastanak u srijedu, 11. novembra, u Narodnoj skupštini ili Vladi RS-a.
SDS proposed a meeting on Wednesday, 11 November, at the National Assembly or the RS Government.
Dodik je ranije rekao da je SDS i PSS prije 5 dana pozvao na razgovore o vladi nacionalnog jedinstva.
Dodik said earlier that he had invited SDS and PSS to talks on a government of national unity 5 days ago.
Vukanović je rekao da ton pisma govori više od 1.000 riječi.
Vukanović said that the tone of the letter says more than 1,000 words.
Po njegovim riječima, Blanuša i Dodik sarađuju od ljeta, a to se više ne krije od javnosti.
In his words, Blanuša and Dodik have been cooperating since the summer, and this is no longer hidden from the public.
Vukanović tvrdi da Stanivuković neće prihvatiti ponudu i da će zato doći do cijepanja PSS-a, odnosno da će se stranka podijeliti.
Vukanović claims that Stanivuković will not accept the offer and that this will lead to a split in PSS, meaning the party will divide.

title: Irak zatvara jedan prijelaz s Iranom, a otvara drugi
Iraq closes one crossing with Iran but opens another
body: Irak je u utorak ponovo otvorio granični prijelaz Sheeb s Iranom, u provinciji Maysan.
On Tuesday Iraq reopened the Sheeb border crossing with Iran, in Maysan province.
U isto vrijeme vlasti su najavile da će od petka zatvoriti prijelaz Mandali u provinciji Diyala.
At the same time the authorities announced that they will close the Mandali crossing in Diyala province from Friday.
Kažu da je razlog tehnički: radovi i modernizacija prije kišne sezone.
They say the reason is technical: works and modernisation before the rainy season.
Prijelaz Sheeb bio je zatvoren od 21. oktobra.
The Sheeb crossing had been closed since 21 October.
Ministar vanjskih poslova Fuad Hussein rekao je da Washington traži da Irak zatvori sve prijelaze s Iranom osim dva.
Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein said that Washington wants Iraq to close all crossings with Iran except two.
Hussein smatra da bi zatvaranje svih prijelaza bilo teško i da bi naštetilo ekonomiji.
Hussein believes that closing all the crossings would be difficult and would harm the economy.
Trgovina između Iraka i Irana vrijedi od 15 do 18 milijardi dolara godišnje.
Trade between Iraq and Iran is worth 15 to 18 billion dollars a year.
Od toga oko 4 milijarde dolara otpada na iranski prirodni plin.
Of that, about 4 billion dollars is for Iranian natural gas.
Nije jasno da li su odluke o prijelazima povezane sa zahtjevom SAD-a.
It is not clear whether the decisions on the crossings are linked to the US request.
Vozači kamiona i trgovci u Maysanu protestovali su zbog zatvaranja, jer su cijene porasle.
Truck drivers and traders in Maysan protested against the closure because prices went up.
Američka vojska je u subotu pokrenula tim „Iron Gate“ koji treba spriječiti prenos oružja preko iranskih granica.
On Saturday the US military launched the "Iron Gate" task force, which is meant to stop weapons being moved across Iran's borders.
Iranska Revolucionarna garda odbacila je tu inicijativu.
Iran's Revolutionary Guard rejected that initiative.

title: Ko je Alexander Alden, čovjek sa sarajevskog Bistrika
Who is Alexander Alden, the man from Sarajevo's Bistrik
body: Klix.ba je saznao nove detalje iz života Alexandera Aldena, koji se ranije zvao Alden Mulabdić.
Klix.ba has learned new details from the life of Alexander Alden, who used to be called Alden Mulabdić.
Rođen je u Italiji, vjerovatno u Veroni, ali je odrastao na Bistriku u Sarajevu.
He was born in Italy, probably in Verona, but he grew up in Bistrik in Sarajevo.
Njegov otac Muhamed bio je u gradu poznat kao Muha, a majka je srpskog porijekla.
His father Muhamed was known in the city as Muha, and his mother is of Serbian origin.
Alden danas ima između 45 i 47 godina.
Alden is now between 45 and 47 years old.
Iz Sarajeva je otišao u Italiju sa 12 godina, a u New York se preselio sa 18, nakon što mu je umro otac.
He left Sarajevo for Italy at 12, and moved to New York at 18, after his father died.
U Americi je napravio akademsku karijeru i promijenio identitet.
In America he built an academic career and changed his identity.
Niko od njegove uže porodice više ne živi u Sarajevu.
None of his close family lives in Sarajevo anymore.
Američki portal Semafor piše da Alden u State Departmentu zastupa političke interese Milorada Dodika.
The American outlet Semafor writes that Alden represents Milorad Dodik's political interests in the State Department.
Prema tom portalu, u junu je pritiskao evropske zvaničnike da prihvate američkog kandidata za visokog predstavnika.
According to that outlet, in June he pressured European officials to accept the American candidate for High Representative.
Evropljani su tog kandidata, italijanskog diplomatu Antonija Zanardija Landija, ipak odbili.
The Europeans nevertheless rejected that candidate, Italian diplomat Antonio Zanardi Landi.
State Department je potvrdio da je Alden bio na sastancima i rekao je da ima puno povjerenje rukovodstva.
The State Department confirmed that Alden was at the meetings and said that he has the full trust of its leadership.
Semafor navodi i da je Vlada RS-a od 2025. potrošila više od 11 miliona dolara na lobiranje kod Trumpove administracije.
Semafor also states that the RS government has spent more than 11 million dollars on lobbying the Trump administration since 2025.

title: Florence Pugh: Žena nikad ne može izgledati kako treba
Florence Pugh: A woman can never look right
body: Britanska glumica Florence Pugh govorila je za magazin ELLE o komentarima na izgled žena u Hollywoodu.
British actress Florence Pugh spoke to ELLE magazine about comments on women's looks in Hollywood.
Ona ima 30 godina i jedna je od zvijezda decembarskog broja tog magazina.
She is 30 years old and one of the stars of the magazine's December issue.
Rekla je da se žene stalno ocjenjuju po izgledu, odjeći i godinama.
She said that women are constantly judged by their looks, clothes and age.
Po njenim riječima, kritike dolaze i kada žena dobije i kada izgubi kilograme.
In her words, criticism comes both when a woman gains and when she loses weight.
Zato smatra da nikad ne možeš pogoditi kako treba.
That is why she thinks you can never get it right.
Pugh kaže da je najbolje uloge imala kada se osjećala najmanje lijepom.
Pugh says she gave her best performances when she felt least beautiful.
Ružna šminka, bolest ili umor daju joj slobodu pred kamerom.
Unflattering make-up, illness or tiredness give her freedom in front of the camera.
Ova godina mogla bi biti najveća u njenoj karijeri, s nekoliko velikih filmova i serijom za Netflix.
This year could be the biggest of her career, with several big films and a series for Netflix.
Glumica je 2022. ispričala da su joj sa 19 godina tražili da promijeni težinu, lice i obrve.
In 2022 the actress said that at 19 she was asked to change her weight, face and eyebrows.
To je bilo nakon što je dobila glavnu ulogu u jednoj seriji.
That was after she got the lead role in a series.
Danas kaže da je naučila zaštititi sebe.
Today she says she has learned to protect herself.
Na snimanju više ne trpi loše ponašanje i želi kolege koji su tačni i puni poštovanja.
On set she no longer tolerates bad behaviour and wants colleagues who are punctual and respectful.

title: Kenan Magoda iz Vlade KS odlazi u Skupštinu
Kenan Magoda leaves the Canton government for the Assembly
body: Ministar kulture i sporta Kantona Sarajevo Kenan Magoda prihvatio je mandat u Skupštini KS.
Sarajevo Canton Culture and Sports Minister Kenan Magoda has accepted a mandate in the Canton Assembly.
On je to u utorak potvrdio za Klix.ba.
He confirmed this to Klix.ba on Tuesday.
Zbog toga više neće biti član kantonalne vlade, jer se te dvije funkcije ne mogu obavljati u isto vrijeme.
Because of this he will no longer be a member of the cantonal government, as the two roles cannot be held at the same time.
Prema Izbornom zakonu BiH, izabrani zastupnik ne može istovremeno raditi u izvršnoj vlasti.
According to the BiH Election Law, an elected representative cannot work in the executive branch at the same time.
Zvaničnici su mogli izabrati i drugi put: da zamrznu mandat i ostanu ministri do formiranja nove vlade.
Officials could also choose another way: freeze the mandate and remain ministers until a new government is formed.
Takvo zamrzavanje ne može trajati kraće od 6 mjeseci.
Such a freeze cannot last less than 6 months.
Prazno mjesto ministra mora se popuniti u roku od 30 dana.
An empty minister's post must be filled within 30 days.
Do tada poslove ministarstva vodi član vlade kojeg odredi premijer.
Until then, the ministry's work is led by a government member whom the prime minister appoints.
Ministar saobraćaja Adnan Šteta, koji je na izborima dobio 21.824 glasa, odlučio je ostati u vladi.
Transport Minister Adnan Šteta, who won 21,824 votes in the elections, decided to stay in the government.
On je zamrznuo mandat u Skupštini.
He froze his mandate in the Assembly.
Premijer Nihad Uk dobio je mjesto u Predstavničkom domu Parlamenta FBiH.
Prime Minister Nihad Uk got a seat in the House of Representatives of the FBiH Parliament.
Ministar za boračka pitanja Omer Osmanović nije direktno izabran u Skupštinu.
Veterans' Affairs Minister Omer Osmanović was not directly elected to the Assembly.

title: Stevandić ponovo predsjednik Narodne skupštine RS-a
Stevandić again speaker of the RS National Assembly
body: Vladajuća koalicija u Republici Srpskoj dogovorila je da Nenad Stevandić ponovo bude predsjednik Narodne skupštine.
The ruling coalition in Republika Srpska agreed that Nenad Stevandić will again be speaker of the National Assembly.
To je u utorak u Banjoj Luci, nakon sastanka koalicije, objavio Milorad Dodik.
Milorad Dodik announced this on Tuesday in Banja Luka, after a coalition meeting.
Dodik je rekao da će RS prva u BiH početi formirati vlast.
Dodik said that RS will be the first in BiH to start forming a government.
Prvo će se izabrati predsjednik i sekretar skupštine.
First the speaker and the secretary of the assembly will be elected.
Nakon toga zakletvu će položiti predsjednik RS-a i srpski član Predsjedništva BiH.
After that the RS president and the Serb member of the BiH Presidency will take the oath.
Zatim slijedi formiranje Vlade RS-a, a na kraju i vlasti na nivou BiH.
Then comes the formation of the RS Government, and finally of the authorities at the BiH level.
Cilj je da budžet RS-a bude usvojen do kraja godine.
The goal is for the RS budget to be adopted by the end of the year.
Koalicioni sporazum trebaju razmotriti stranke, a potpisivanje je najavljeno za iduću sedmicu.
The parties need to review the coalition agreement, and the signing is announced for next week.
Na nivou BiH koalicija ima 9 mjesta u Predstavničkom domu.
At the BiH level the coalition has 9 seats in the House of Representatives.
Koalicija je prije 5 dana pozvala SDS i PSS na razgovore o vladi nacionalnog jedinstva.
Five days ago the coalition invited SDS and PSS to talks on a government of national unity.
SDS je bio spreman na sastanak, ali ne u prostorijama SNSD-a, dok PSS nije razumio dnevni red.
SDS was ready for a meeting, but not at SNSD's premises, while PSS did not understand the agenda.
Dodik je rekao da obje stranke propuštaju priliku da budu ozbiljne.
Dodik said that both parties are missing a chance to be serious.
Koalicija im je ponudila novi sastanak u srijedu u 17 sati u prostorijama SDS-a.
The coalition offered them a new meeting on Wednesday at 5 p.m. at SDS's premises.

title: Kako se zaštititi od zagađenog zraka
How to protect yourself from polluted air
body: Zrak u Sarajevu u ponedjeljak navečer bio je vrlo zagađen.
The air in Sarajevo was very polluted on Monday evening.
U 21 sat prosječna koncentracija sitnih čestica PM2.5 bila je 92 mikrograma po kubnom metru.
At 9 p.m. the average concentration of fine PM2.5 particles was 92 micrograms per cubic metre.
Do 15 sati u utorak pala je na 34, ali je na stanici Sarajevsko polje zrak i dalje bio zagađen.
By 3 p.m. on Tuesday it fell to 34, but at the Sarajevsko polje station the air was still polluted.
Između 13 i 14 sati najgori zrak u Federaciji BiH imao je Lukavac, a zatim Živinice i Ilidža.
Between 1 and 2 p.m. Lukavac had the worst air in the Federation of BiH, followed by Živinice and Ilidža.
Prema Svjetskoj zdravstvenoj organizaciji, zagađen zrak je 2019. uzrokovao oko 4,2 miliona preranih smrti u svijetu.
According to the World Health Organization, polluted air caused about 4.2 million premature deaths worldwide in 2019.
Zavod za javno zdravstvo KS upozorava da zagađenje iritira oči i disajne puteve.
The Sarajevo Canton Public Health Institute warns that pollution irritates the eyes and airways.
Može izazvati kašalj i otežano disanje, a pogoršava i bolesti srca i pluća.
It can cause coughing and difficulty breathing, and it also worsens heart and lung diseases.
Najugroženiji su djeca, trudnice, stariji ljudi i hronični bolesnici.
Those most at risk are children, pregnant women, older people and the chronically ill.
Stručnjaci savjetuju da ljudi provode manje vremena napolju i ne vježbaju vani.
Experts advise people to spend less time outdoors and not to exercise outside.
Ako ljudi moraju izaći, trebaju nositi dobro zatvorenu masku FFP2 ili N95.
If people have to go out, they should wear a tight-fitting FFP2 or N95 mask.
Te maske ne štite od plinova i ne smiju se koristiti kod djece mlađe od 2 godine.
These masks do not protect against gases and must not be used on children under 2.
Stan treba kratko provjetriti kada je zagađenje najmanje, a u kući ne treba pušiti.
A flat should be aired briefly when pollution is lowest, and people should not smoke indoors.
Ko se grije na peć, trebao bi ugraditi detektor ugljen-monoksida i nikad ne paliti smeće.
Anyone who heats with a stove should install a carbon monoxide detector and never burn rubbish.

title: Meteor iznad Cape Coda prema Zemlji je vjerovatno poslao Jupiter
Jupiter probably sent the Cape Cod meteor toward Earth
body: Meteor koji je 30. maja eksplodirao iznad američke savezne države Massachusetts vjerovatno je prema Zemlji skrenuo Jupiter.
The meteor that exploded over the US state of Massachusetts on 30 May was probably deflected toward Earth by Jupiter.
Do tog zaključka došao je tim od 13 naučnika iz Evrope i SAD-a.
A team of 13 scientists from Europe and the US reached that conclusion.
Eksplozija je izazvala dvostruki prasak koji se čuo širom sjeveroistoka SAD-a, a dijelovi su pali u zaljev Cape Cod.
The explosion caused a double boom that was heard across the northeastern US, and pieces fell into Cape Cod Bay.
Tim je vodio Juha Vierinen s Arktičkog univerziteta Norveške u Tromsøu.
The team was led by Juha Vierinen of the Arctic University of Norway in Tromsø.
Naučnici su koristili podatke radara, kamera i infrazvučnih senzora, koji bilježe zvuk preniske frekvencije za ljudsko uho.
The scientists used data from radars, cameras and infrasound sensors, which record sound too low in frequency for the human ear.
Radar je pratio meteor od 90 do 71 kilometar visine, a raspao se na samo oko 30 kilometara.
Radar tracked the meteor from 90 to 71 kilometres of altitude, and it broke apart at only about 30 kilometres.
Prema mjerenjima, eksplozija je oslobodila energiju od oko 500 tona TNT-a.
According to the measurements, the explosion released energy of about 500 tons of TNT.
Objekat je imao oko 1 metar, bio je čvrst i vjerovatno bogat željezom.
The object was about 1 metre across, it was strong and probably rich in iron.
Njegova orbita oko Sunca bila je izdužena i dosezala je skoro do Jupitera.
Its orbit around the Sun was elongated and reached almost to Jupiter.
Član tima Marc Fries rekao je da je objekat vjerovatno prošao blizu Jupitera, koji ga je usmjerio prema Zemlji.
Team member Marc Fries said that the object probably passed close to Jupiter, which sent it toward Earth.
Naučnici nisu pronašli vezu s nekim poznatim tijelom ili kišom meteora.
The scientists found no link to any known body or meteor shower.
Kažu da se tako mali objekti teško otkriju u svemiru, pa je ovo rijetka prilika za istraživanje.
They say that such small objects are hard to detect in space, so this is a rare chance for research.

title: Šteta ostaje ministar do nove Vlade KS
Šteta stays minister until the new KS government
body: Adnan Šteta, ministar saobraćaja Kantona Sarajevo, ostat će na funkciji do imenovanja nove vlade.
Adnan Šteta, the Sarajevo Canton transport minister, will stay in office until a new government is appointed.
On je član SDP-a BiH.
He is a member of SDP BiH.
Svoj mandat u Skupštini Kantona Sarajevo stavlja u mirovanje, a preuzet će ga kada se vlada formira.
He is putting his mandate in the Sarajevo Canton Assembly on hold, and he will take it up once the government is formed.
Odluku je objavio na društvenoj mreži.
He announced the decision on social media.
Zahvalio je biračima na 21.824 glasa.
He thanked voters for 21,824 votes.
Kaže da je to najviše glasova koje je dobio ijedan kandidat za kantonalne skupštine u Federaciji BiH.
He says this is the most votes received by any candidate for cantonal assemblies in the Federation of BiH.
Pozvao je novu skupštinsku većinu da što prije formira vladu.
He called on the new assembly majority to form the government as soon as possible.
Prije nego što dođe nasljednik, predstavit će izvještaj o radu u 10 oblasti.
Before his successor arrives, he will present a report on his work in 10 areas.
Taj izvještaj opisuje završene i otvorene projekte, kao i planirane aktivnosti.
The report describes completed and ongoing projects, as well as planned activities.
Šteta kaže da će tako olakšati predaju dužnosti.
Šteta says this will make the handover easier.
SDP će, rekao je, preuzeti političku odgovornost u skladu s povjerenjem građana.
SDP will, he said, take political responsibility in line with citizens' trust.
Dodao je da njegova stranka neće blokirati procese kako neki priželjkuju.
He added that his party will not block processes as some wish.

title: Ko je Alden, Trumpov čovjek za politiku prema Dodiku
Who is Alden, the Trump aide behind the policy on Dodik
body: Američki medij Semafor objavio je tekst o Alexanderu Aldenu, nekada Mulabdiću.
The US outlet Semafor has published an article about Alexander Alden, formerly Mulabdić.
On je savjetnik državnog sekretara Marca Rubija i Trumpov kandidat za ambasadora u Azerbejdžanu.
He is an adviser to Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Trump's nominee for ambassador to Azerbaijan.
Prema više od šest izvora, imao je vodeću ulogu u politici Vašingtona prema Miloradu Dodiku i Republici Srpskoj.
According to more than six sources, he had a leading role in Washington's policy towards Milorad Dodik and Republika Srpska.
Neki kolege su ga, kažu izvori, zvali Srbinom u State Departmentu.
Some colleagues, the sources say, called him a Serb in the State Department.
Pet izvora tvrdi da je u junu na sastancima o BiH pritiskao evropske zvaničnike da prihvate američkog kandidata za visokog predstavnika.
Five sources claim that in June, at meetings about BiH, he pressed European officials to accept the US candidate for High Representative.
Dvojica izvora kažu da je lično izabrao italijanskog diplomatu Antonija Zanardija Landija, ali su ga Evropljani odbili.
Two sources say he personally chose the Italian diplomat Antonio Zanardi Landi, but the Europeans rejected him.
Vlada Republike Srpske je od 2025. potrošila više od 11 miliona dolara na lobiranje kod Trumpove administracije.
Since 2025, the government of Republika Srpska has spent more than 11 million dollars on lobbying the Trump administration.
To je otprilike četiri puta više nego u periodu od 2022. do 2024.
That is about four times more than in the period from 2022 to 2024.
Senatorica Jeanne Shaheen poručila je da oni koji su iskvarili američku politiku moraju odgovarati.
Senator Jeanne Shaheen said that those who corrupted US policy must be held accountable.
State Department tvrdi da Alden uživa puno povjerenje rukovodstva.
The State Department says that Alden enjoys the full confidence of the leadership.
Senatori su razmatrali njegovu nominaciju, ali ga nije bilo na dnevnom redu.
Senators have considered his nomination, but he was not on the agenda.
Semafor navodi da bi mogao dobiti pitanja o lobiranju za interese Republike Srpske.
Semafor reports that he could get questions about lobbying for the interests of Republika Srpska.

title: Hadžikadunić propušta utakmice sa Švedskom i Rumunijom
Hadžikadunić misses the matches against Sweden and Romania
body: Odbrambeni igrač Dennis Hadžikadunić neće igrati protiv Švedske i Rumunije.
Defender Dennis Hadžikadunić will not play against Sweden and Romania.
Obje utakmice su dio Lige nacija.
Both matches are part of the Nations League.
Savez je objavio da je on na pripreme došao povrijeđen.
The federation announced that he came to the preparations already injured.
Danas nije trenirao u Butmiru.
He did not train today in Butmir.
Prema pisanju Liste, riječ je o rupturi mišića lijeve potkoljenice.
According to Lista, it is a ruptured muscle in the left lower leg.
Vijest je stigla na samom početku priprema pod selektorom Sergejom Barbarezom.
The news came right at the start of preparations under coach Sergej Barbarez.
Za Barbareza je to veliki problem, jer je Hadžikadunić važan igrač u odbrani.
For Barbarez this is a big problem, because Hadžikadunić is an important player in defence.
Reprezentacija je tek obavila drugi trening.
The national team has only just held its second training session.
Hadžikadunić je i u septembru i oktobru propustio utakmice reprezentacije.
Hadžikadunić also missed national team matches in September and October.
Tada je tek pokušavao uhvatiti formu nakon prelaska u Hajduk iz Splita.
At that time he was still trying to find form after moving to Hajduk from Split.
Sada je redovno u prvoj postavi kluba i dobro igra ove sezone.
Now he regularly starts for the club and is playing well this season.
Zato je njegova povreda još veća šteta za Zmajeve.
That is why his injury is an even bigger loss for the Dragons.

title: Bičakčić: Do 350 kWh struja ne mora poskupjeti
Bičakčić: Electricity does not have to get more expensive up to 350 kWh
body: Elektroprivreda BiH ne isključuje poskupljenje struje za domaćinstva u 2027. godini.
Elektroprivreda BiH does not rule out a rise in electricity prices for households in 2027.
Odluka se očekuje do sredine decembra.
A decision is expected by mid-December.
Edhem Bičakčić, počasni predsjednik komiteta CIGRE, rekao je za Klix.ba da bi domaćinstva do 350 kWh mjesečno mogla proći bez poskupljenja.
Edhem Bičakčić, honorary president of the CIGRE committee, told Klix.ba that households using up to 350 kWh a month could avoid a price rise.
On smatra da bi ostali potrošači morali platiti više.
He thinks other consumers would have to pay more.
U Federaciji BiH vrijedi blok tarifa, a potrošnja do 350 kWh smatra se socijalnom kategorijom.
In the Federation of BiH a block tariff applies, and consumption up to 350 kWh is seen as a social category.
Za industriju je već najavljeno poskupljenje od 30 posto, što je veliki udarac za privredu.
A 30 percent rise has already been announced for industry, which is a big blow to the economy.
Bičakčić kaže da su Koksara i Željezara već stali s radom.
Bičakčić says that Koksara and Željezara have already stopped working.
Dodaje da su računi za struju trenutno niži od računa za internet i kablovsku televiziju, što on ne smatra normalnim.
He adds that electricity bills are currently lower than bills for internet and cable TV, which he does not consider normal.
Grijanje na struju je sada najjeftinije, pa se mnogi domaćinstva vraćaju s drva i peleta na struju.
Electric heating is now the cheapest, so many households are switching from wood and pellets to electricity.
Socijalno ugrožene porodice mogu se prijaviti za besplatne solarne panele.
Socially vulnerable families can apply for free solar panels.
Domaćinstva s većom potrošnjom mogu dobiti podršku do 7.000 KM.
Households with higher consumption can get support of up to 7,000 KM.
Bičakčić je rekao da zapošljavanje u Elektroprivredi ne može ići po stranačkoj liniji.
Bičakčić said that hiring in Elektroprivreda cannot follow party lines.

title: Bugarska: u lančanom sudaru poginulo 11 osoba
Bulgaria: 11 people died in a chain-reaction crash
body: U Bugarskoj se u utorak oko 7 sati dogodila velika saobraćajna nesreća.
A big traffic accident happened in Bulgaria on Tuesday around 7 a.m.
Na autoputu Trakija, blizu grada Jambola, sudarilo se oko 50 vozila.
On the Trakia motorway, near the town of Yambol, about 50 vehicles collided.
Među njima su bili automobili, autobusi, kombiji i kamioni.
They included cars, buses, vans and trucks.
Premijer Rumen Radev rekao je da je poginulo najmanje 11 osoba.
Prime Minister Rumen Radev said that at least 11 people died.
Povrijeđeno je oko 50 ljudi, a svi su prevezeni u bolnice.
About 50 people were injured, and all were taken to hospitals.
Vlasti kažu da su uzroci gusta magla, mokar kolovoz i prevelika brzina.
Authorities say the causes were thick fog, a wet road and too much speed.
Autoput je zatvoren u oba smjera.
The motorway is closed in both directions.
Snimak iz zraka, koji je objavila televizija Nova, pokazuje smrskana i prevrnuta vozila na više od šest traka.
Aerial footage released by Nova TV shows crushed and overturned vehicles across more than six lanes.
Radev je za nesreću saznao dok je putovao u Varnu na sastanak s Ursulom von der Leyen.
Radev learned of the crash while travelling to Varna for a meeting with Ursula von der Leyen.
Naredio je ministru unutrašnjih poslova da odmah ode u Burgas i prebaci povrijeđene u Sofiju.
He ordered the interior minister to go to Burgas immediately and move the injured to Sofia.
Radev je najavio i da će posjetiti mjesto nesreće.
Radev also announced that he would visit the crash site.
Predsjednica Evropske komisije izrazila je saučešće porodicama žrtava.
The President of the European Commission expressed condolences to the victims' families.

title: Kup BiH: Željezničar gostuje u Mostaru, Borac u Gabeli
BiH Cup: Željezničar plays away in Mostar, Borac in Gabela
body: U Nogometnom savezu BiH održan je žrijeb osmine finala Kupa Bosne i Hercegovine.
The draw for the round of 16 of the Bosnia and Herzegovina Cup was held at the Football Association of BiH.
Željezničar će gostovati u Mostaru kod Zrinjskog.
Željezničar will play away at Zrinjski in Mostar.
Borac iz Banje Luke igrat će kod GOŠK-a u Gabeli.
Borac from Banja Luka will play GOŠK in Gabela.
Utakmice su na rasporedu 30. i 31. januara 2027. godine.
The matches are scheduled for 30 and 31 January 2027.
Među ostalim parovima su Famos i Posušje, Radnik i TOŠK te Tomislav i Travnik.
Other pairs include Famos and Posušje, Radnik and TOŠK, and Tomislav and Travnik.
Igra se samo jedna utakmica, pa nema popravnog ispita.
Only one match is played, so there is no second chance.
Ako nakon 90 minuta nema pobjednika, odmah slijede jedanaesterci.
If there is no winner after 90 minutes, penalties follow straight away.
Od četvrtfinala se igra dvomeč, kod kuće i u gostima.
From the quarter-finals, two legs are played, at home and away.
Već su poznati i mogući parovi četvrtfinala.
The possible quarter-final pairs are also already known.
Pobjednik para Zrinjski i Željezničar igrat će protiv pobjednika para Zvijezda i Čelik.
The winner of Zrinjski and Željezničar will play the winner of Zvijezda and Čelik.
Pobjednik para GOŠK i Borac čeka pobjednika para Sloga i BSK.
The winner of GOŠK and Borac will face the winner of Sloga and BSK.
Tačni termini bit će objavljeni nakon žrijeba za četvrtfinale.
The exact dates will be announced after the quarter-final draw.

title: Mustafić: Nisam ostavio ni fening duga Narodnom pozorištu
Mustafić: I did not leave a single fening of debt at the National Theatre
body: Reditelj Dino Mustafić odbacio je optužbe da je Narodno pozorište Sarajevo doveo do kolapsa.
Director Dino Mustafić has rejected accusations that he brought the National Theatre Sarajevo to collapse.
Bio je direktor te ustanove, a o tome je govorio na BHRT-u.
He was the director of that institution, and he spoke about it on BHRT.
Rekao je da nije ostavio ni fening duga.
He said that he did not leave a single fening of debt.
Objasnio je da direktor ne može praviti dugove bez dokumenata i strogog nadzora ministarstava kulture i finansija.
He explained that a director cannot make debts without documents and strict oversight by the ministries of culture and finance.
Naveo je i brojke o radu pozorišta.
He also gave figures about the theatre's work.
Vlastiti prihodi bili su oko 900.000 KM u 2023, milion KM u 2024. i 1.425.000 KM u 2025.
Its own revenue was about 900,000 KM in 2023, 1 million KM in 2024 and 1,425,000 KM in 2025.
Od 2021. do 2025. bilo je 48 premijera, 34 nagrade i više od 200.000 gledalaca.
From 2021 to 2025 there were 48 premieres, 34 awards and more than 200,000 viewers.
Pozorište je, kaže, nastupilo i na 98 festivala.
The theatre, he says, also performed at 98 festivals.
Govorio je i o zgradi pozorišta.
He also spoke about the theatre building.
Prema ugovoru koji je potpisao, fasada je trebala biti gotova do 31. decembra 2025, ali taj rok nije ispoštovan.
According to the contract he signed, the facade was to be finished by 31 December 2025, but that deadline was not met.
Kritikovao je i političke napade na Narodno pozorište.
He also criticised political attacks on the National Theatre.
Spomenuo je i Omladinsko pozorište u Mostaru, koje nakon 54 godine prijeti zatvaranje.
He also mentioned the Youth Theatre in Mostar, which faces closure after 54 years.

title: SpaceX prvi put pokušava uhvatiti oba dijela Starshipa
SpaceX tries for the first time to catch both parts of Starship
body: SpaceX planira prvi put uhvatiti oba dijela svoje velike rakete Starship.
SpaceX plans to catch both parts of its big Starship rocket for the first time.
To su prvi stepen Super Heavy i gornji dio, nazvan Starship.
These are the first stage Super Heavy and the upper part, called Starship.
Petnaesti probni let planiran je za petak, 13. novembra, u terminu od 75 minuta.
The 15th test flight is planned for Friday, 13 November, in a 75-minute window.
Oba dijela trebala bi se vratiti na lansirno mjesto Starbase u južnom Teksasu.
Both parts should return to the Starbase launch site in southern Texas.
Tamo ih hvataju metalne ruke tornja, koje zovu štapići za jelo.
There, metal arms of the tower, which they call chopsticks, catch them.
Super Heavy bi se trebao vratiti oko 6,5 minuta nakon polijetanja.
Super Heavy should return about 6.5 minutes after liftoff.
SpaceX je do sada tri puta uhvatio prvi stepen, ali nikada nije pokušao uhvatiti gornji dio.
SpaceX has caught the first stage three times so far, but has never tried to catch the upper part.
To je teže jer gornji dio leti više i dalje.
This is harder because the upper part flies higher and farther.
Starship bi trebao stići u orbitu i ispustiti 26 satelita Starlink V3.
Starship should reach orbit and release 26 Starlink V3 satellites.
Oko Zemlje će kružiti na visini od oko 275 kilometara, otprilike 14 puta, više od 22 sata.
It will circle the Earth at a height of about 275 kilometres, roughly 14 times, for more than 22 hours.
Prethodni let, 28. septembra, završio je slijetanjem u Tihi okean nakon tri sata.
The previous flight, on 28 September, ended with a landing in the Pacific Ocean after three hours.
Ako nešto pođe po zlu, SpaceX će odustati od povratka na Starbase.
If something goes wrong, SpaceX will give up on the return to Starbase.

title: Budite li se noću zbog toaleta? Kada je to znak bolesti
Do you wake at night to use the toilet? When it is a sign of illness
body: Ponekad se probuditi noću zbog toaleta je normalno.
Sometimes waking at night to use the toilet is normal.
Ako se to dešava dva ili više puta svake noći, urolozi to smatraju nenormalnim.
If it happens two or more times every night, urologists consider it abnormal.
Odrasli bi trebali spavati šest do osam sati bez odlaska u toalet.
Adults should sleep six to eight hours without going to the toilet.
Ovaj problem zove se nokturija i on je simptom, a ne bolest.
This problem is called nocturia, and it is a symptom, not a disease.
U SAD-u ga ima oko 50 miliona odraslih, uglavnom starijih od 65 godina.
In the US about 50 million adults have it, mostly people older than 65.
Mogući uzroci su dijabetes, apneja u snu, prekomjerno aktivan mjehur i uvećana prostata.
Possible causes are diabetes, sleep apnea, an overactive bladder and an enlarged prostate.
Kod dijabetesa bubrezi izbacuju višak šećera zajedno s vodom, pa se češće mokri.
With diabetes the kidneys push out extra sugar together with water, so people urinate more often.
Kod uvećane prostate mjehur se slabije prazni, pa se čovjek osjeća kao da je stalno pun.
With an enlarged prostate the bladder empties worse, so a man feels as if it is always full.
Ljekaru treba otići ako se buđenje događa redovno, ako je novo ili ako se pogoršava.
You should go to a doctor if the waking happens regularly, if it is new or if it gets worse.
Odmah treba tražiti pomoć ako se pojave bol pri mokrenju, jaka žeđ ili oticanje nogu.
You should seek help at once if pain when urinating, strong thirst or swelling of the legs appear.
Stručnjaci savjetuju da se dva sata prije spavanja ne pije tekućina, posebno alkohol i kafa.
Experts advise not drinking liquids two hours before sleep, especially alcohol and coffee.
Neke lijekove za pritisak možda je bolje uzimati ujutro, ali o tome treba pitati ljekara.
Some medicines for blood pressure may be better taken in the morning, but you should ask a doctor about it.

title: Nafta u svijetu jeftinija, a dizel u BiH skuplji
Oil is cheaper in the world, but diesel in BiH is more expensive
body: Cijena nafte na svjetskom tržištu pala je na najniži nivo od augusta.
The price of oil on the world market has fallen to its lowest level since August.
Brent, referentna nafta za Evropu, u utorak ujutro koštao je oko 92 dolara po barelu.
Brent, the reference oil for Europe, cost about 92 dollars a barrel on Tuesday morning.
Tržište očekuje da će rat na Bliskom istoku završiti diplomatskim putem.
The market expects the war in the Middle East to end through diplomacy.
Pad traje već drugu sedmicu, a 2. novembra Brent je bio iznad 107 dolara.
The fall has lasted for a second week, and on 2 November Brent was above 107 dollars.
U Federaciji BiH dizel je ipak postao skuplji nego ranije.
In the Federation of BiH, however, diesel has become more expensive than before.
Prosječna cijena 9. novembra bila je 3,82 KM po litru, a to je najviše u posljednja tri mjeseca.
The average price on 9 November was 3.82 KM a litre, which is the highest in the last three months.
Najjeftiniji dizel je u Bihaću, gdje košta 3,63 KM, a najskuplji je na jednoj pumpi na Ilidži.
The cheapest diesel is in Bihać, where it costs 3.63 KM, and the most expensive is at one petrol station in Ilidža.
Benzin Super 95 u prosjeku košta 3,27 KM, a autoplin 1,48 KM po litru.
Super 95 petrol costs 3.27 KM on average, and autogas 1.48 KM a litre.
Donald Trump je rekao da je malo vjerovatno da će odobriti nove udare na Iran ako pregovori napreduju.
Donald Trump said it is unlikely that he will approve new strikes on Iran if the talks make progress.
Tržišta sada čekaju podatke o inflaciji u SAD-u, koji bi mogli uticati na kretanje nafte.
The markets are now waiting for inflation data from the US, which could affect the movement of oil.

title: Smrt pacijenta u Zagrebu: otkazi u psihijatrijskoj bolnici
A patient's death in Zagreb: dismissals at the psychiatric hospital
body: U psihijatrijskoj bolnici Jankomir u Zagrebu prije skoro tri sedmice umro je 32-godišnji bivši sportista Kristian Josip Periša.
Almost three weeks ago, 32-year-old former athlete Kristian Josip Periša died at the Jankomir psychiatric hospital in Zagreb.
Četiri medicinska tehničara poslana su u istražni zatvor na mjesec dana.
Four medical technicians have been sent to pretrial detention for one month.
Sumnjiče se da su prema pacijentu upotrijebili preveliku silu, što je dovelo do njegove smrti.
They are suspected of using too much force against the patient, which led to his death.
Direktorica bolnice Majda Grah dala je trojici od njih vanredne otkaze.
The hospital director Majda Grah gave extraordinary dismissals to three of them.
Rekla je da je to morala učiniti po vlastitoj savjesti nakon što je pregledala situaciju.
She said she had to do it according to her own conscience after she had looked into the situation.
Priznala je da bolnici nedostaje osoblja i da nisu svi radnici dovoljno educirani.
She admitted that the hospital lacks staff and that not all workers are well enough trained.
Sindikat traži zaštitare, obuku za samoodbranu i tim koji brzo reaguje na agresivne pacijente.
The union is asking for security guards, self-defence training and a team that reacts quickly to aggressive patients.
Porodica osporava priču bolnice, a advokat tvrdi da pacijent nije bio ovisnik i traži da se sačuvaju snimci kamera.
The family disputes the hospital's story, and the lawyer claims that the patient was not an addict and asks that camera footage be kept.
Ministarstvo zdravstva poslalo je inspekciju u bolnicu.
The Ministry of Health has sent an inspection to the hospital.
Ministrica Irena Hrstić rekla je da je situacija jako zabrinjavajuća.
Minister Irena Hrstić said that the situation is very worrying.

title: Emisije CO2 blago pale, naučnici krive rat u Iranu
CO2 emissions fell slightly, scientists blame the war in Iran
body: Svjetske emisije ugljik-dioksida ove su godine blago pale.
World emissions of carbon dioxide have fallen slightly this year.
Prema procjeni Globalnog projekta za ugljik, 2026. godine ispušteno je 42,2 milijarde tona CO2 iz fosilnih goriva, a to je 0,4 posto manje nego prošle godine.
According to the estimate of the Global Carbon Project, 42.2 billion tonnes of CO2 from fossil fuels were released in 2026, which is 0.4 percent less than last year.
Analizu je pripremilo više od 140 naučnika, a predstavljena je na klimatskim razgovorima UN-a u Antaliji.
More than 140 scientists prepared the analysis, and it was presented at the UN climate talks in Antalya.
Naučnici kažu da razlog nije klimatski napredak, nego rat u Iranu.
Scientists say that the reason is not climate progress, but the war in Iran.
Zbog rata je Hormuški moreuz praktično zatvoren, pa su cijene goriva i nafte porasle.
Because of the war the Strait of Hormuz is practically closed, so fuel and oil prices have gone up.
Emisije iz nafte pale su skoro 2 posto, iz plina 0,3 posto, a iz uglja su porasle 0,6 posto.
Emissions from oil fell almost 2 percent, from gas 0.3 percent, and from coal they rose 0.6 percent.
Kina, SAD, Evropa i Japan bilježe pad od oko 1 posto, dok su emisije u Indiji porasle 4,4 posto.
China, the US, Europe and Japan recorded a fall of about 1 percent, while emissions in India rose 4.4 percent.
Ovo je tek treći put u ovom vijeku da emisije padaju, nakon krize 2009. i pandemije 2020.
This is only the third time in this century that emissions fall, after the crisis of 2009 and the pandemic of 2020.
Glen Peters rekao je da su to u neku ruku male dobre vijesti, ali iz pogrešnih razloga.
Glen Peters said that this is in a way a little good news, but for the wrong reasons.
Niklas Höhne vidi trajnu promjenu zbog brzog prelaska na električne automobile i kamione u Aziji.
Niklas Höhne sees a lasting change because of the quick switch to electric cars and trucks in Asia.

title: Lijekovi za mršavljenje dobijaju upozorenje o riziku za vid
Weight-loss drugs get a warning about a risk to eyesight
body: Američka agencija za lijekove FDA objavila je da će popularni lijekovi za mršavljenje imati novo upozorenje.
The US drug agency FDA announced that popular weight-loss drugs will carry a new warning.
Riječ je o riziku od gubitka vida, koji je rijedak.
It is about the risk of vision loss, which is rare.
Upozorenje će stajati na svim lijekovima iz grupe GLP-1, a to je dvanaest preparata u obliku injekcija ili tableta.
The warning will be on all drugs from the GLP-1 group, which means twelve products in the form of injections or tablets.
Među njima su Ozempic, Wegovy, Zepbound i Mounjaro.
Among them are Ozempic, Wegovy, Zepbound and Mounjaro.
Problem se zove nearteritička prednja ishemijska optička neuropatija i može izazvati veliki gubitak vida.
The problem is called nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy and it can cause a great loss of vision.
FDA kaže da je povezan sa slabijim dotokom krvi do očnog živca, ali pravi uzrok nije poznat.
The FDA says it is linked to weaker blood flow to the optic nerve, but the real cause is not known.
Analiza više od 125 kliničkih studija pokazala je da se on javlja kod oko 6 na 100.000 pacijenata koji koriste ove lijekove najmanje godinu dana.
An analysis of more than 125 clinical trials showed that it appears in about 6 in 100,000 patients who use these drugs for at least a year.
Kod pacijenata na placebu ili drugim lijekovima za šećer taj broj je ispod 4 na 100.000.
In patients on a placebo or other sugar-lowering drugs, that number is below 4 in 100,000.
FDA je počela provjeravati problem nakon što je jedan medicinski rad iz 2024. povezao oštećenje vida sa semaglutidom.
The FDA began checking the problem after a medical paper from 2024 linked eye damage to semaglutide.
Simptomi su zamućen vid, slijepe tačke i izobličene boje.
The symptoms are blurred vision, blind spots and distorted colours.
Pacijenti koji ih primijete trebaju odmah kontaktirati ljekara.
Patients who notice them should contact a doctor immediately.

title: Šef Nvidije priznao vezu sa osobom pod sumnjom za špijunažu
The head of Nvidia admitted a relationship with a person suspected of spying
body: Direktor kompanije Nvidia Jensen Huang našao se u centru skandala.
The chief executive of Nvidia, Jensen Huang, has ended up at the centre of a scandal.
U nedjelju je u e-poruci zaposlenima priznao da je imao ljubavnu vezu sa Alice Huang, koja nije u srodstvu s njim.
On Sunday he admitted in an email to employees that he had a romantic relationship with Alice Huang, who is not related to him.
Američke obavještajne službe navodno smatraju da ona radi za kinesku vladu.
US intelligence services reportedly believe that she works for the Chinese government.
Huang je napisao da mu je duboko žao.
Huang wrote that he is deeply sorry.
Prema magazinu Wired, Huang još od oktobra 2025. sarađuje s agencijom Heller, koja savjetuje moćne ljude u skandalima.
According to Wired magazine, since October 2025 Huang has worked with the agency Heller, which advises powerful people in scandals.
Nakon što je New York Times pisao o njegovim poslovima sa singapurskom firmom Megaspeed, Nvidia je tražila da Heller bude uključen u sve upite novinara.
After the New York Times wrote about his deals with the Singaporean firm Megaspeed, Nvidia asked that Heller be included in all journalists' questions.
Ministarstvo trgovine SAD-a navodno istražuje pomaže li Megaspeed kineskim firmama da zaobiđu izvozna ograničenja za čipove.
The US Commerce Department is reportedly investigating whether Megaspeed helps Chinese firms get around export limits on chips.
Uprava Nvidije pokrenula je nezavisnu istragu i poručila da nema razloga za sumnju da su ugroženi nacionalna sigurnost ili povjerljivi podaci.
Nvidia's board has started an independent investigation and said there is no reason to think national security or confidential data were put at risk.
Trump je u nedjelju navečer branio Huanga i rekao da je on pošten čovjek.
On Sunday evening Trump defended Huang and said he is an honest man.
Dodao je da misli da Huang treba ostati direktor.
He added that he thinks Huang should stay as chief executive.

title: U Mostaru niče nova zgrada Autocesta FBiH
A new Autoceste FBiH building is rising in Mostar
body: U centru Mostara raste nova poslovna zgrada javnog preduzeća Autoceste FBiH.
In the centre of Mostar a new business building of the public company Autoceste FBiH is rising.
Zgrada je već izašla iz temelja, a na gradilištu rade dizalice.
The building has already come up out of the foundations, and cranes are working on the site.
Nalazi se na raskrsnici ulica Dr. Ante Starčevića i Jakova Baruha Španca, pored zgrade HNK.
It is at the crossing of Dr. Ante Starčevića and Jakova Baruha Španca streets, next to the HNK building.
Autoceste kažu da radovi teku po planu i da radnici dolaze svaki dan.
Autoceste say that the works are going to plan and that workers come every day.
Ugovor vrijedi 21,68 miliona KM s PDV-om i potpisan je prošlog novembra.
The contract is worth 21.68 million KM including VAT and was signed last November.
Posao radi konzorcij na čelu s mostarskim Promarkom, a rok je 22 mjeseca.
A consortium led by Promark from Mostar is doing the job, and the deadline is 22 months.
Zgrada će imati 7.250 kvadratnih metara, dvije podzemne i osam nadzemnih etaža.
The building will have 7,250 square metres, two underground and eight above-ground floors.
Grijanje i hlađenje bit će uglavnom na solarnu i geotermalnu energiju.
Heating and cooling will mostly use solar and geothermal energy.
Poseban sistem upravljat će instalacijama, rasvjetom, liftovima i alarmom za požar.
A special system will manage the installations, lighting, lifts and the fire alarm.
Autoceste su ranije rekle da njihove službe rade u iznajmljenim prostorijama, što je dugoročan trošak.
Autoceste said earlier that their departments work in rented rooms, which is a long-term cost.

title: Trump: Rat s Iranom mogao bi brzo završiti
Trump: The war with Iran could end quickly
body: Američki predsjednik Donald Trump rekao je da bi rat s Iranom mogao prilično brzo završiti.
US President Donald Trump said that the war with Iran could end fairly quickly.
Govorio je u ponedjeljak na konferenciji za novinare u Bijeloj kući, nakon sastanka s premijerom Katara.
He spoke on Monday at a press conference in the White House, after a meeting with the prime minister of Qatar.
Dodao je da nove vojne akcije protiv Irana trenutno ne izgledaju potrebne.
He added that new military action against Iran does not seem necessary at the moment.
Ipak je upozorio da ništa ne garantuje.
Still, he warned that he guarantees nothing.
Trump je rekao da su SAD spremne za akciju ako se moraju vratiti u sukob.
Trump said that the US is ready for action if it has to return to the conflict.
Razgovor s premijerom Katara opisao je kao odličan i rekao da su dugo govorili o Iranu.
He described the talk with the prime minister of Qatar as excellent and said they spoke about Iran for a long time.
Na mreži Truth Social napisao je da Katar, Saudijska Arabija i druge zemlje regije žele da stanje ostane isto.
On the Truth Social network he wrote that Qatar, Saudi Arabia and other countries of the region want the situation to stay the same.
To uključuje pomorsku blokadu Irana i novu operaciju koja pritisak sa mora širi na kopno.
That includes the naval blockade of Iran and a new operation that spreads the pressure from the sea to land.
Prema njegovim riječima, promjena situacije na Bliskom istoku sada je prilično malo vjerovatna.
According to him, a change of the situation in the Middle East is now quite unlikely.
Reuters-u je rekao da Katar više voli miran dogovor.
He told Reuters that Qatar prefers a peaceful agreement.
Ponovio je da Iran nikada ne smije imati nuklearno oružje.
He repeated that Iran must never have nuclear weapons.

title: Paul McCartney je milijarder, piše Forbes
Paul McCartney is a billionaire, Forbes writes
body: Magazin Forbes objavio je da je Paul McCartney postao milijarder.
Forbes magazine has announced that Paul McCartney has become a billionaire.
Njegovo bogatstvo procjenjuje na najmanje 1,4 milijarde dolara.
It estimates his wealth at no less than 1.4 billion dollars.
Bivši član Beatlesa ima 84 godine i treći je najbogatiji muzičar na svijetu.
The former Beatles member is 84 years old and is the third richest musician in the world.
Ispred njega su samo Jay-Z s 2,8 milijardi i Taylor Swift s 2 milijarde dolara.
Only Jay-Z with 2.8 billion and Taylor Swift with 2 billion dollars are ahead of him.
Najveći dio novca dolazi od kompanije MPL Communications, koju je osnovao 1969. godine.
The biggest part of the money comes from the company MPL Communications, which he founded in 1969.
Ona posjeduje prava na pjesme drugih umjetnika, mjuzikle i božićne pjesme, a Forbes je procjenjuje na najmanje 250 miliona dolara.
It owns rights to songs of other artists, musicals and Christmas songs, and Forbes values it at no less than 250 million dollars.
Kompanija Apple Corps, koja pripada Beatlesima, zarađuje više od 50 miliona dolara godišnje.
The company Apple Corps, which belongs to the Beatles, earns more than 50 million dollars a year.
Svaki od četiri vlasnika ima 25 posto, a udio vrijedi više od 150 miliona dolara.
Each of the four owners has 25 percent, and a share is worth more than 150 million dollars.
McCartney je sudovima vratio prava na pjesme Beatlesa, koja donose najmanje 10 miliona godišnje.
McCartney won back the rights to the Beatles' songs through the courts, and they bring in at least 10 million a year.
Ima i nekretnine u Velikoj Britaniji i Hamptonsu te zbirku umjetnina s djelima Picassa i Magrittea.
He also has property in Great Britain and in the Hamptons and a collection of art with works by Picasso and Magritte.
Forbes kaže da McCartney nije htio komentarisati procjene.
Forbes says that McCartney did not want to comment on the estimates.

title: Dodik: Vladu RS-a formirat ćemo brže nego drugi u BiH
Dodik: We will form the RS government faster than others in BiH
body: Lider SNSD-a Milorad Dodik rekao je da će Vlada Republike Srpske biti formirana brže nego druge vlade u BiH.
SNSD leader Milorad Dodik said that the government of Republika Srpska will be formed faster than other governments in BiH.
Govorio je nakon sastanka predstavnika stranaka u Narodnoj skupštini.
He spoke after a meeting of party representatives in the National Assembly.
Stranke su se dogovorile o formiranju novog saziva bez političkih nesuglasica.
The parties agreed on forming the new assembly without political disagreements.
Dodik kaže da počinje period stabilnosti u kojem će vladajuća koalicija ostati na vlasti.
Dodik says a period of stability is starting in which the ruling coalition will stay in power.
Prema njegovim riječima, koaliciju će ojačati dodatni ljudi.
In his words, additional people will strengthen the coalition.
Na konstituirajućoj sjednici Skupština će izabrati predsjednika i druga tijela.
At the constitutive session, the Assembly will elect its president and other bodies.
Zakletvu će položiti i član Predsjedništva BiH Željka Cvijanović i predsjednik RS-a.
The member of the BiH Presidency Željka Cvijanović and the RS president will also take their oath.
Savo Minić je danas u Centralnoj izbornoj komisiji preuzeo mandat predsjednika RS-a.
Savo Minić took over the mandate of RS president today at the Central Election Commission.
Rekao je da će zakletvu položiti na konstituirajućoj sjednici.
He said he will take the oath at the constitutive session.
Dodik je objasnio da predsjednik RS-a nakon zakletve može odmah predložiti mandatara za novu vladu.
Dodik explained that after the oath the RS president can immediately nominate a mandatary for the new government.
Dodik je dodao da je dan svečan, ali i radni.
Dodik added that the day is ceremonial, but also a working day.
Siguran je da će nastavak saradnje ubrzati formiranje vlade.
He is sure that continued cooperation will speed up forming the government.

title: Vukanović tvrdi da je Dodik na papiriću zapisao ko prelazi u SNSD
Vukanović claims Dodik wrote on a slip of paper who is moving to SNSD
body: Nebojša Vukanović tvrdi da je Milorad Dodik na malom papiru zapisao koji opozicioni poslanici prelaze u SNSD.
Nebojša Vukanović claims that Milorad Dodik wrote on a small piece of paper which opposition deputies are moving to SNSD.
Vukanović je to rekao novinarima nakon sastanka u Narodnoj skupštini Republike Srpske.
Vukanović told reporters this after a meeting in the National Assembly of Republika Srpska.
Sastanak je održan prije konstituisanja novog saziva skupštine.
The meeting was held before the new assembly convenes.
Prema njegovim riječima, na papiru piše da jedan poslanik SDS-a prelazi u Ujedinjenu Srpsku, a drugi bi trebao preći u SNSD.
According to him, the paper says that one SDS deputy is moving to Ujedinjena Srpska, and another should move to SNSD.
Zapisano je i da tri poslanika PSS-a idu u SNSD, a čeka se još troje.
It also says that three PSS deputies are going to SNSD, and three more are awaited.
Maja Dragojević iz PSS-a, kako piše na papiru, ide kod Banjca.
Maja Dragojević from PSS, as the paper says, goes to Banjac.
Vukanović je rekao da je to ono što je napisano na papiriću.
Vukanović said this is what was written on the paper.
Ipak, ne zna se da li će sve biti tačno, a to će se vidjeti u narednom periodu.
However, it is not known whether everything will be true, and that will be seen in the coming period.
Vukanović je dodao da će sjednica u ponedjeljak u svakom slučaju biti zanimljiva.
Vukanović added that the session on Monday will be interesting in any case.
Predsjednik Narodne skupštine Nenad Stevandić rekao je da se Vukanović na tom sastanku dva puta uzdržao i da niko nije glasao protiv.
The president of the National Assembly, Nenad Stevandić, said that Vukanović abstained twice at that meeting and that nobody voted against.
Vukanovićeve tvrdnje za sada nisu potvrđene.
Vukanović's claims have not been confirmed so far.

title: Procurili podaci: U ratu poginulo blizu pola miliona ruskih vojnika
Leaked data: Nearly half a million Russian soldiers killed in the war
body: Hakeri su došli do podataka ruske statističke službe Rosstat, koji pokazuju veliki broj mrtvih ruskih vojnika u Ukrajini.
Hackers got hold of data from the Russian statistics service Rosstat, which show a large number of dead Russian soldiers in Ukraine.
O tome je pisao britanski list The Guardian.
The British paper The Guardian wrote about it.
Podatke je analizirao Janis Kluge, šef odjela za Rusiju u jednom njemačkom institutu.
The data was analysed by Janis Kluge, head of the Russia department at a German institute.
On je rekao da su brojke šokantne i veće od većine procjena.
He said the figures are shocking and bigger than most estimates.
Baza sadrži više od 11 miliona potvrda o smrti, a u 412.576 njih smrt je povezana s ratom.
The database contains more than 11 million death notices, and in 412,576 of them the death is linked to the war.
Krajem 2024. i tokom 2025. umiralo je više od 15.000 vojnika mjesečno, otprilike 500 dnevno.
In late 2024 and during 2025, more than 15,000 soldiers died every month, about 500 a day.
Najteže su pogođeni najsiromašniji regioni na istoku Rusije.
The poorest regions in eastern Russia were hit hardest.
U Burjatiji, Tuvi i Zabajkalskom kraju rat je do sredine 2024. činio otprilike trećinu svih smrti muškaraca od 18 do 49 godina.
In Buryatia, Tuva and Zabaykalsky Krai, the war made up about a third of all deaths of men aged 18 to 49 until mid-2024.
Kluge upozorava da je pravi broj vjerovatno veći, jer se smrti upisuju sa zakašnjenjem od oko šest mjeseci.
Kluge warns that the real number is probably higher, because deaths are recorded with a delay of about six months.
Prema njegovim riječima, sada smo bliže 500.000 mrtvih nego 400.000.
In his words, we are now closer to 500,000 dead than to 400,000.
The Guardian nije mogao sam provjeriti cijelu bazu, ali kaže da se brojke slažu s drugim procjenama.
The Guardian could not check the whole database itself, but says the figures match other estimates.
Rosstat je potvrdio napad hakera, ali tvrdi da osjetljivi podaci nisu ukradeni.
Rosstat confirmed the hacker attack, but claims sensitive data was not stolen.
Izvor blizak Putinu rekao je da će ovakvi gubici prije učvrstiti njegove namjere nego ga natjerati na dogovor.
A source close to Putin said such losses are more likely to harden his intentions than push him toward a deal.

title: Putnički voz iz BiH ponovo vozi za Beograd od 13. decembra
Passenger train from BiH to Belgrade runs again from 13 December
body: Vlada Republike Srpske odobrila je novi red vožnje za putničke vozove za 2026/2027. godinu.
The Government of Republika Srpska approved a new timetable for passenger trains for 2026/2027.
Pripremile su ga Željeznice Republike Srpske, a počinje da važi 13. decembra.
It was prepared by Željeznice Republike Srpske, and it takes effect on 13 December.
Najvažnija novost je nova linija od Zvornika do Beograda i nazad.
The most important novelty is a new line from Zvornik to Belgrade and back.
Željeznice su se za tu liniju dogovorile s beogradskim prevoznikom Srbijavoz.
The railway company agreed on this line with the Belgrade operator Srbijavoz.
Kažu da je linija posebno važna za stanovnike zvorničkog kraja, koji su posljednjih godina morali koristiti drugi prevoz.
They say the line is especially important for residents of the Zvornik area, who in recent years had to use other transport.
Plan predviđa i 13 putničkih vozova u unutrašnjem saobraćaju.
The plan also includes 13 passenger trains in domestic traffic.
Troškovi vuče iznose 2.729.367,80 KM godišnje.
Traction costs are 2,729,367.80 KM per year.
Dogovoreno je i povezivanje s Hrvatskim željeznicama, a putnici će mijenjati voz u Volinji.
A connection with Croatian Railways was also agreed, and passengers will change trains at Volinja.
Vozovi na liniji Banjaluka – Novi Grad – Dobrljin bit će povezani s vozovima u Volinji, ali vremena još nisu usaglašena s hrvatskom stranom.
Trains on the Banja Luka – Novi Grad – Dobrljin line will connect with trains at Volinja, but the times have not yet been agreed with the Croatian side.
To je rekao vršilac dužnosti direktora Dragan Zelenković.
This was said by acting director Dragan Zelenković.
Željeznice su prevezle 62.100 putnika u 2025. godini, a u prvih deset mjeseci ove godine skoro 25.000.
The railways carried 62,100 passengers in 2025 and almost 25,000 in the first ten months of this year.
Pad objašnjavaju manjim brojem linija prošle godine.
They explain the drop by the smaller number of lines last year.

title: Šta znače rokovi trajanja na hrani
What the expiry dates on food mean
body: Na ambalaži hrane često piše „upotrijebiti do“ ili „najbolje upotrijebiti do“, a te dvije oznake nisu isto.
Food packaging often says "use by" or "best before", and these two labels are not the same.
Prva oznaka govori o sigurnosti, a druga o kvalitetu.
The first label is about safety, and the second is about quality.
Obje su obavezne u BiH, a Agencija za sigurnost hrane objasnila je razliku u smjernicama iz decembra 2024.
Both are required in BiH, and the Food Safety Agency explained the difference in guidelines from December 2024.
Hranu s oznakom „upotrijebiti do“ ne treba jesti nakon tog datuma, čak i ako izgleda i miriše dobro.
Food marked "use by" should not be eaten after that date, even if it looks and smells fine.
To su svježe meso i riba, svježi mliječni proizvodi, hladna gotova jela i svježe cijeđeni sokovi.
These are fresh meat and fish, fresh dairy products, cold ready meals and freshly squeezed juices.
Oznaka „najbolje upotrijebiti do“ pokazuje do kada hrana zadržava boju, okus i miris.
The "best before" label shows how long food keeps its colour, taste and smell.
Ako je pakovanje zatvoreno i hrana je dobro čuvana, ona je često sigurna još neko vrijeme.
If the package is closed and the food was stored well, it is often safe for some time longer.
Brašno, šećer, tjestenina, riža, kafa i konzerve mogu trajati i do godinu dana poslije tog datuma.
Flour, sugar, pasta, rice, coffee and canned food can last up to a year after that date.
Čokolada, majoneza i žitarice traju oko dva mjeseca duže.
Chocolate, mayonnaise and cereals last about two months longer.
Kolače, šunku i jogurt bolje je baciti kada rok istekne.
Cakes, ham and yogurt are better thrown away when the date passes.
Bebi-hrana se nikada ne smije koristiti nakon datuma.
Baby food must never be used after the date.
Hranu treba baciti ako ima plijesan, užegao miris, promijenjenu boju ili insekte, ili ako je konzerva zardala ili nabubrila.
Food should be thrown away if it has mould, a rancid smell, changed colour or insects, or if a can is rusty or swollen.
EUFIC navodi da se čak 10% hrane koja se baci u EU veže za pogrešno razumijevanje ovih oznaka.
EUFIC says that up to 10% of the food wasted in the EU is linked to misunderstanding these labels.

title: Trump sumnja u izbore nakon poraza Republikanaca
Trump doubts the elections after the Republicans' defeat
body: Američki predsjednik Donald Trump dovodi u pitanje ispravnost izbora u kojima su Republikanci izgubili.
US President Donald Trump is questioning the fairness of the elections in which the Republicans lost.
Demokrate su dobile obje kuće Kongresa na izborima na polovini mandata.
The Democrats won both chambers of Congress in the midterm elections.
Trump je na mreži Truth Social napisao: „Da li iko zaista vjeruje da su ovi izbori bili pošteni?“
On Truth Social, Trump wrote: "Does anyone really believe these elections were fair?"
Krivio je ankete i mašine za glasanje.
He blamed the polls and the voting machines.
Tvrdio je da su neke grupe glasačkih listića bile toliko velike da Republikanci nisu mogli pobijediti, ali nije pokazao nikakve dokaze.
He claimed that some batches of ballots were so large that Republicans could not have won, but he showed no evidence.
Napisao je i da je sve u mašinama, koje su važnije od glasača.
He also wrote that it is all about the machines, which are more important than voters.
Stručnjaci su ranije upozoravali na takve tvrdnje.
Experts had warned earlier against such claims.
Neke države prebroje poštanske glasove odmah i objave ih čim se birališta zatvore, pa prvi rezultati mogu ići u korist Demokrata.
Some states count mail-in ballots right away and publish them as soon as polling stations close, so the first results can favour the Democrats.
Mašine za glasanje nisu spojene na internet i prije izbora se detaljno testiraju.
Voting machines are not connected to the internet and are tested thoroughly before elections.
Prema podacima agencije AP, Demokrate u Senatu imaju 54 mjesta, a Republikanci 44.
According to the AP agency, Democrats have 54 seats in the Senate and Republicans 44.
U Predstavničkom domu Demokrate imaju 254 mjesta, a Republikanci 162.
In the House of Representatives the Democrats have 254 seats and the Republicans 162.
To je najveća demokratska većina u tom domu od 2008. godine.
This is the largest Democratic majority in that chamber since 2008.
Trump je u nedjelju rekao da je Amerika napravila veliki korak unazad, ali nije rekao da su izbori namješteni.
On Sunday Trump said America took a big step backward, but he did not say the elections were rigged.

title: Camara dobio mjesto u Haasu, a kratkovid je i nosi sočiva
Camara got the Haas seat, but he is short-sighted and wears lenses
body: Rafael Camara, 21-godišnji Brazilac, debitovao je prošle sedmice u Formuli 1 na Velikoj nagradi Sao Paula.
Rafael Camara, a 21-year-old Brazilian, made his Formula 1 debut last week at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Haas ga je potvrdio kao zamjenu za Estebana Ocona u sezoni 2027.
Haas confirmed him as the replacement for Esteban Ocon in the 2027 season.
Za mjesto su se borila dva vozača iz Ferrarijeve akademije: Camara i Dino Beganović, Šveđanin bosanskog porijekla.
Two drivers from the Ferrari academy fought for the seat: Camara and Dino Beganović, a Swede of Bosnian descent.
Sada je poznato da Camara ima zdravstvenih problema s vidom.
It is now known that Camara has health problems with his sight.
Kratkovid je i ima astigmatizam, a dioptrija mu je -2,75 i -2,50.
He is short-sighted and has astigmatism, and his prescription is -2.75 and -2.50.
Zbog astigmatizma mu se svjetla čine veoma jaka, pa u bolidu nosi kontaktna sočiva.
Because of the astigmatism, lights seem very strong to him, so he wears contact lenses in the car.
To je rekao u intervjuu za zvanični prenos Formule 2.
He said this in an interview for the official Formula 2 broadcast.
Ispričao je i smiješnu priču iz Formule Regional.
He also told a funny story from Formula Regional.
Prije kvalifikacija je u hotelu zaboravio sočiva, a nije imao vremena da ih donese.
Before qualifying he forgot his lenses at the hotel and had no time to bring them.
Vozio je s naočalama i spustio vizir kaciga da ga tim ne vidi.
He drove with glasses and lowered his helmet visor so the team would not see him.
Kvalifikacije je završio kao drugi, manje od pola desetinke sekunde iza pole pozicije.
He finished qualifying second, less than half a tenth of a second behind pole position.
Kaže da je zbog naočala izgubio pole poziciju.
He says he lost pole position because of his glasses.

title: Photo East Fest u decembru: poziv fotografima da šalju radove
Photo East Fest in December: photographers invited to send their work
body: Foto-kino klub Istočno Sarajevo organizuje festival fotografije Photo East Fest od 4. do 6. decembra.
The Foto-kino klub Istočno Sarajevo is organising the photography festival Photo East Fest from 4 to 6 December.
Na festivalu će biti izložbe, radionice, predavanja i susreti s umjetnicima.
The festival will include exhibitions, workshops, lectures and meetings with artists.
Klub poziva fotografe da pošalju radove za drugu međunarodnu izložbu fotografije.
The club invites photographers to send works for the second international photography exhibition.
Prijave su otvorene od 5. novembra, a zatvaraju se 25. novembra u 23:59.
Entries have been open since 5 November and close on 25 November at 23:59.
Žiri će raditi od 26. do 29. novembra, a rezultati će biti objavljeni 1. decembra.
The jury will work from 26 to 29 November, and the results will be published on 1 December.
Postoje tri kategorije: otvorena u boji, otvorena crno-bijela i nova tema „Ljudi“.
There are three categories: open colour, open black-and-white and the new theme "People".
Autori mogu poslati najviše četiri fotografije po kategoriji, dakle ukupno 12.
Authors can send at most four photos per category, so 12 in total.
Bit će podijeljeno 18 medalja i 30 priznanja, a kotizacija je 10 eura.
18 medals and 30 commendations will be awarded, and the entry fee is 10 euros.
Festival počinje 4. decembra radionicom za srednjoškolce, a uveče slijedi razgovor o umjetnosti i film „Foto Nomad“.
The festival starts on 4 December with a workshop for high school students, and in the evening there is an art talk and the film "Foto Nomad".
Otvaranje festivala i izložbe je 5. decembra u 19:00 u Galeriji Žarko Vidović.
The opening of the festival and the exhibition is on 5 December at 19:00 in the Žarko Vidović Gallery.
Posljednjeg dana, 6. decembra, predavanje će održati Goran Kukić, koji će predstaviti i svoju izložbu.
On the last day, 6 December, Goran Kukić will give a lecture and will also present his exhibition.
Organizatori pozivaju sve ljubitelje fotografije da dođu u Istočno Sarajevo.
The organisers invite all photography fans to come to East Sarajevo.

title: Navike koje pomažu ljudima koji se bore s anksioznošću
Habits that help people who struggle with anxiety
body: Ljudi koji žive s anksioznošću često se oslanjaju na poznate stvari, na primjer na istu hranu, omiljenu seriju ili ustaljenu rutinu.
People who live with anxiety often rely on familiar things, for example the same food, a favourite series or a fixed routine.
Te navike ne rješavaju sve probleme, ali pomažu kada osoba osjeti da gubi kontrolu.
These habits do not solve every problem, but they help when a person feels they are losing control.
Svako ko živi s anksioznošću ima svoj način da pronađe utjehu.
Everyone who lives with anxiety has their own way of finding comfort.
Omiljene serije su siguran izbor jer su likovi i radnja poznati, a kraj se zna unaprijed.
Favourite series are a safe choice because the characters and plot are known, and the ending is known in advance.
Slično je i u restoranu: ako unaprijed znate šta ćete naručiti, osjećate se mirnije.
It is similar in a restaurant: if you know in advance what you will order, you feel calmer.
Drugima to može izgledati kao izbirljivost, ali razlog je često strah da će se osoba osjećati loše nakon nove hrane.
To others this may look like pickiness, but the reason is often fear of feeling sick after new food.
U nepoznatim prostorima, na primjer u koncertnoj dvorani, anksiozni ljudi prvo pronađu izlaze, što im donosi mir.
In unfamiliar places, for example a concert hall, anxious people first find the exits, which brings them calm.
Neki osjećaju veliku tjeskobu zbog dogovorenih planova, pa im je lakše kada neko drugi otkaže.
Some feel great dread about agreed plans, so it is easier for them when someone else cancels.
Neki ljudi imaju i vremensku anksioznost: stalno gledaju na sat i često dođu oko 15 minuta ranije.
Some people also have time anxiety: they constantly watch the clock and often arrive about 15 minutes early.
Igrice i muzika također mogu pomoći, jer na trenutak odvlače misli od briga.
Games and music can also help, because they briefly take thoughts away from worries.
Stručnjaci navode da ista rutina u stresnom periodu smanjuje napetost, a male navike, kao što je ujutro pospremiti krevet, daju osjećaj kontrole.
Experts say that the same routine in a stressful period reduces tension, and small habits, such as making the bed in the morning, give a sense of control.
Anksioznost može stvoriti i potrebu za kontrolom, pa se mnogi najsigurnije osjećaju kada sami voze automobil.
Anxiety can also create a need for control, so many feel safest when they drive the car themselves.

title: Savo Minić preuzeo mandat predsjednika RS-a, vlada do 15. decembra
Savo Minić took the RS president's mandate; government by 15 December
body: Savo Minić je u Sarajevu u CIK-u potpisao izjavu o prihvatanju mandata predsjednika Republike Srpske.
In Sarajevo, Savo Minić signed a statement accepting the mandate of president of Republika Srpska at the CIK.
Do sada je bio premijer, a sve ovlasti premijera prenio je na ministra Kuzmića.
Until now he was prime minister, and he handed all the prime minister's powers to minister Kuzmić.
Minić kaže da je potpisom u CIK-u zapravo postao predsjednik.
Minić says that with his signature at the CIK he actually became president.
Mandat je prihvatio da bi izbjegao pravne sporove.
He accepted the mandate to avoid legal disputes.
Izmjene Izbornog zakona nazvao je nametnutim i rekao da ih treba tumačiti Parlamentarna skupština BiH, a ne CIK.
He called the changes to the Election Law imposed and said that the Parliamentary Assembly of BiH, not the CIK, should interpret them.
Zakletvu će položiti u ponedjeljak na konstitutivnoj sjednici Narodne skupštine RS-a.
He will take the oath on Monday at the constitutive session of the RS National Assembly.
Nakon toga će od Siniše Karana preuzeti Ustav, a posao počinje u utorak.
After that he will receive the Constitution from Siniša Karan, and work starts on Tuesday.
Nova vlada RS-a bit će formirana najkasnije do 15. decembra, a razgovori počinju odmah.
The new RS government will be formed by 15 December at the latest, and talks start immediately.
Na kritike Elmedina Konakovića o raspodjeli državnih funkcija nije htio davati detalje.
He did not want to give details in response to Elmedin Konaković's criticism about the distribution of state posts.
Rekao je samo da je njegova strana odlično pobijedila.
He said only that his side won clearly.

title: Stari saziv Doma naroda FBiH možda bira delegata bez funkcije
The outgoing House of Peoples of the FBiH may elect a delegate who will never serve
body: Četiri delegata Doma naroda BiH podnijela su ostavku jer su izabrani u Predstavnički dom.
Four delegates of the BiH House of Peoples resigned because they were elected to the House of Representatives.
Riječ je o Džemalu Smajiću, Dženanu Đonlagiću, Iliji Cvitanoviću i Želimiru Neškoviću, rekao je član CIK-a Suad Arnautović.
They are Džemal Smajić, Dženan Đonlagić, Ilija Cvitanović and Želimir Nešković, said CIK member Suad Arnautović.
Prema starim listama, njihova mjesta trebaju preuzeti Mirnes Gušić, Mensura Beganović, Ivan Vukadin i Tamara Evđić.
According to the old lists, their seats should be taken by Mirnes Gušić, Mensura Beganović, Ivan Vukadin and Tamara Evđić.
Problem je u tome što su Gušić i Vukadin osvojili i mandate u kantonalnim skupštinama.
The problem is that Gušić and Vukadin also won seats in cantonal assemblies.
Ako ih prihvate, Cvitanovićevo mjesto bi pripalo Željku Josiću.
If they accept them, Cvitanović's seat would go to Željko Josić.
Gušićeva lista imala je samo dva imena, pa zakon ne kaže ko je sljedeći.
Gušić's list had only two names, so the law does not say who is next.
CIK bi zato mogao tražiti vanrednu sjednicu odlazećeg Doma naroda FBiH.
The CIK could therefore ask for an extraordinary session of the outgoing FBiH House of Peoples.
Situacija se zove bizarnom jer novi delegati vjerovatno nikada neće raditi.
The situation is called bizarre because the new delegates will probably never work.
Ovaj saziv uskoro završava, pa oni neće položiti zakletvu niti primati platu.
This convocation ends soon, so they will not take the oath or receive a salary.
To je prva primjena pravila o mirovanju mandata poslije općih izbora.
This is the first use of the rule on suspended mandates after the general elections.

title: Tragovi kanabisa nađeni u sibirskoj grobnici staroj 2.800 godina
Traces of cannabis found in a 2,800-year-old Siberian tomb
body: Međunarodni tim naučnika pronašao je oko 1.000 sjemenki kanabisa u drevnoj grobnici u južnom Sibiru.
An international team of scientists found about 1,000 cannabis seeds in an ancient tomb in southern Siberia.
Istraživanje je vodio arheolog Gino Caspari sa Univerziteta u Bernu.
The research was led by archaeologist Gino Caspari of the University of Bern.
Grobnica Tunnug 1 u Tuvi pripadala je visokopozicioniranoj osobi iz skitskog naroda.
The tomb Tunnug 1 in Tuva belonged to a high-ranking person of the Scythian people.
Šest sjemenki datirano je radiokarbonskom metodom, a rezultati pokazuju da su stavljene u grobnicu početkom 8. vijeka prije nove ere.
Six seeds were dated by the radiocarbon method, and the results show they were put into the tomb in the early 8th century BCE.
U kosi iz središnje komore nađeni su tragovi kanabinola, spoja koji nastaje iz THC-a.
In hair from the central chamber, traces of cannabinol were found, a compound that forms from THC.
Naučnici kažu da je to najstariji direktno datiran dokaz upotrebe kanabisa zbog opojnog učinka.
The scientists say this is the oldest directly dated evidence of cannabis use for its intoxicating effect.
Studija ne može pokazati koliko je kanabisa korišteno, niti da li su ga ljudi pušili ili jeli.
The study cannot show how much cannabis was used, or whether people smoked or ate it.
Sjemenke vjerovatno potiču od divljih biljaka.
The seeds probably come from wild plants.
Caspari kaže da je kanabis imao važnu ulogu u obredima oko sahrane.
Caspari says that cannabis had an important role in rituals around burial.
Studija je objavljena 5. novembra u časopisu Science.
The study was published on 5 November in the journal Science.

title: Kako je jedna greška na konferenciji srušila Berlinski zid
How one mistake at a press conference brought down the Berlin Wall
body: Danas je godišnjica pada Berlinskog zida, koji je Berlin dijelio od 1961. godine.
Today is the anniversary of the fall of the Berlin Wall, which divided Berlin from 1961.
Istočnonjemačke vlasti počele su zatvarati granicu prema Zapadnom Berlinu 13. augusta te godine.
East German authorities began closing the border to West Berlin on 13 August of that year.
Do 1989. kod zida je poginulo najmanje 140 ljudi.
By 1989 at least 140 people had died at the wall.
