Večer 9. novembra 1989. zvaničnik Günter Schabowski objavio je nova pravila putovanja za Istočne Nijemce.
On the evening of 9 November 1989, official Günter Schabowski announced new travel rules for East Germans.
Na pitanje novinara kada počinju, odgovorio je da odmah, bez odlaganja.
Asked by a journalist when they start, he answered that it was immediately, without delay.
Prijelaz Bornholmer Straße propustio je prve ljude u 21:20, a oko 23:30 komandant je podigao rampu.
The Bornholmer Straße crossing let the first people through at 21:20, and around 23:30 the commander lifted the barrier.
Za sat vremena granicu je prešlo oko 20.000 ljudi.
Within an hour about 20,000 people crossed the border.
Većina zida srušena je između juna i novembra 1990, a Njemačka je ujedinjena 3. oktobra.
Most of the wall was torn down between June and November 1990, and Germany was reunified on 3 October.
Berlin je obilježio godišnjicu kod Memorijala na ulici Bernauer Straße, uz oko 170 manifestacija.
Berlin marked the anniversary at the Memorial on Bernauer Straße, with about 170 events.
Novi izvještaj pokazuje da je prosječna neto imovina domaćinstva na istoku 125.500 eura, a na zapadu 257.100.
A new report shows that average net household assets are 125,500 euros in the East and 257,100 in the West.

title: PSV objavio novi snimak driblinga Bajraktarevića
PSV published a new video of Bajraktarević's dribble
body: PSV je na Instagramu objavio novi snimak driblinga bh. reprezentativca Esmira Bajraktarevića.
PSV published a new video of the dribbling of Bosnian international Esmir Bajraktarević on Instagram.
Akcija je iz 19. minute utakmice 12. kola Eredivisie, koju je PSV dobio protiv Cambuura sa 5:2.
The action is from the 19th minute of the Eredivisie round 12 match, which PSV won against Cambuur 5-2.
Bajraktarević je ušao u šesnaesterac, ostavio braniča bez odgovora i dodao Rubenu van Bommelu.
Bajraktarević entered the penalty area, left the defender helpless and passed to Ruben van Bommel.
Van Bommel je postigao gol za 3:0.
Van Bommel scored for 3-0.
Bajraktarević je tako upisao petu asistenciju u sezoni, jednu više nego u cijeloj prošloj.
Bajraktarević thus made his fifth assist of the season, one more than in the whole of the last one.
Počeo je utakmicu jer je trener Peter Bosz odmarao Ivana Perišića, koji je imao povredu glave.
He started the match because coach Peter Bosz rested Ivan Perišić, who had a head injury.
Asistirao je i kod prvog gola Svena Mijnansa u prvoj minuti, a Mijnans je zabio tri gola.
He also assisted Sven Mijnans's first goal in the first minute, and Mijnans scored three.
Zamijenjen je u 86. minuti, a Voetbal International mu je dao ocjenu 7,5.
He was substituted in the 86th minute, and Voetbal International gave him a rating of 7.5.
Navijači su poslije trećeg gola bacali čaše i flaše pa je utakmica nakratko prekinuta.
After the third goal fans threw cups and bottles, so the match was briefly stopped.
PSV je pobjedom prešao na vrh tabele s 26 bodova, jedan više od Feyenoorda i Ajaxa.
With the win, PSV moved to the top of the table with 26 points, one more than Feyenoord and Ajax.

title: Trump priznao da je pretjerao s deportacijama
Trump admitted he went too far with deportations
body: Donald Trump je u prvom velikom intervjuu poslije izbora priznao da je politika deportacija bila prestroga.
In his first big interview after the elections, Donald Trump admitted that his deportation policy was too harsh.
U emisiji "60 Minutes" rekao je da ga je to koštalo podrške birača.
On "60 Minutes" he said it cost him voters' support.
Prema CBS-u, republikanci su izgubili više od 40 mjesta u Predstavničkom domu i najmanje sedam u Senatu.
According to CBS, Republicans lost more than 40 seats in the House of Representatives and at least seven in the Senate.
Trump misli da su na rezultat uticali i deportacije ljudi s dobrim poslovima i slaba ekonomska poruka.
Trump thinks the result was also affected by the deportation of people with good jobs and a weak economic message.
Izlazne ankete CBS-a pokazuju da 63 posto birača ne odobrava njegov rad.
CBS exit polls show that 63 percent of voters disapprove of his work.
Njih 58 posto smatra da je vlast otišla predaleko u pitanju imigracije.
58 percent of them think the administration went too far on immigration.
Trump želi dogovor s demokratama za ljude koji dugo žive u zemlji, poput konobara i vrtlara.
Trump wants a deal with the Democrats for people who have lived in the country for a long time, such as waiters and gardeners.
Priznao je i da se biračima nije dopao rat s Iranom i da ne želi eskalaciju.
He also admitted that voters did not like the war with Iran and that he does not want escalation.
Obećao je da će prije kraja mandata dati veliki broj pomilovanja.
He promised to grant a large number of pardons before the end of his term.
Sat poslije intervjua objavio je da će Stephen Miller zamijeniti Susie Wiles na mjestu šefa kabineta.
An hour after the interview he announced that Stephen Miller will replace Susie Wiles as chief of staff.

title: Robbie Williams neće tužiti Oliviju Rodrigo zbog pjesme
Robbie Williams will not sue Olivia Rodrigo over a song
body: Pjevač Robbie Williams rekao je da neće tužiti Oliviju Rodrigo zbog sličnosti njenih pjesama s njegovom.
Singer Robbie Williams said he will not sue Olivia Rodrigo over similarities between her song and his.
Slušaoci na društvenim mrežama uporedili su njenu božićnu pjesmu "Take Me Home 4 Christmas" s njegovim hitom "Candy" iz 2012.
Listeners on social media compared her Christmas song "Take Me Home 4 Christmas" with his 2012 hit "Candy".
Rodrigo je pjesmu objavila prošle sedmice.
Rodrigo released the song last week.
Williams, koji ima 52 godine, kaže da su takve reakcije razumljive, ali da se sličnost može desiti slučajno.
Williams, who is 52, says such reactions are understandable, but that a similarity can happen by accident.
Dodao je da neće ići protiv nje i da ne zna ima li tu veze s autorskim pravima.
He added that he will not go against her and that he does not know whether copyright is involved.
Pohvalio je i njenu pjesmu "Brutal" i rekao da bi voljao da ju je on napisao.
He also praised her song "Brutal" and said he would have liked to have written it himself.
Pjesmu su s Rodrigo napisali Dan Nigro i Amy Allen, a inspiracija je bila "Christmas Wrapping" grupe The Waitresses iz 1981.
The song was written with Rodrigo by Dan Nigro and Amy Allen, and the inspiration was "Christmas Wrapping" by The Waitresses from 1981.
Rodrigo je tražila dozvolu od osnivača grupe Chrisa Butlera, a on ju je odobrio.
Rodrigo asked for permission from the group's founder Chris Butler, and he approved it.
Slične optužbe čula je i ranije, na primjer za pjesmu "Good 4 U".
She has heard similar accusations before, for example for the song "Good 4 U".

title: Građani BiH u Hrvatskoj kupili 464 nekretnine u 2025.
BiH citizens bought 464 properties in Croatia in 2025
body: Građani BiH su prošle godine u Hrvatskoj kupili 464 nekretnine.
BiH citizens bought 464 properties in Croatia last year.
Prema podacima hrvatske Porezne uprave, to ih svrstava na četvrto mjesto među stranim kupcima.
According to data from the Croatian Tax Administration, this puts them in fourth place among foreign buyers.
Kupili su više od Čeha, Mađara i Poljaka, ali manje od Slovenaca, Nijemaca i Austrijanaca.
They bought more than Czechs, Hungarians and Poles, but fewer than Slovenes, Germans and Austrians.
Slovenci su kupili 2.576 nekretnina, Nijemci 1.962, a Austrijanci 875.
Slovenes bought 2,576 properties, Germans 1,962, and Austrians 875.
Stranci su ukupno kupili 9.159 nekretnina, što je 31 posto manje nego u rekordnoj 2022.
Foreigners bought 9,159 properties in total, which is 31 percent fewer than in the record year 2022.
Ipak, to je 59 posto više nego 2016. godine, a kupovina građana BiH je osam puta veća.
Still, that is 59 percent more than in 2016, and purchases by BiH citizens are eight times higher.
Najviše stranaca kupovalo je u Istri, gdje je prodano 2.635 nekretnina.
Most foreigners bought in Istria, where 2,635 properties were sold.
Slijede Zadarska županija s 1.789 i Primorsko-goranska s 1.543 kupovine.
Zadar County follows with 1,789 and Primorje-Gorski Kotar with 1,543 purchases.
Hrvatska gospodarska komora navodi da oko 90 posto stranaca kupuje u primorskim županijama.
The Croatian Chamber of Economy says that about 90 percent of foreigners buy in coastal counties.
Porezna uprava dodaje da se brojke još mogu promijeniti.
The Tax Administration adds that the figures may still change.

title: Zašto smo umorni poslije ručka i kako to ublažiti
Why we feel tired after lunch and how to reduce it
body: Mnogi ljudi poslije ručka osjećaju pospanost, a to se ljekarski zove postprandijalna somnolencija.
Many people feel sleepy after lunch, and this is medically called postprandial somnolence.
Dijetetičarka Erin Palinski-Wade kaže da tijelo prirodno gubi budnost obično između 14 i 16 sati.
Dietitian Erin Palinski-Wade says the body naturally loses alertness, usually between 2 and 4 p.m.
Taj pad se dešava čak i ako potpuno preskočite ručak.
This dip happens even if you skip lunch completely.
Nedostatak sna pojačava umor, a velik obrok ga čini još gorim.
Lack of sleep increases tiredness, and a large meal makes it even worse.
U jednoj studiji ljudi koji su spavali pet sati pravili su mnogo više grešaka u vožnji nakon ručka od 922 kalorije.
In one study, people who slept five hours made many more driving errors after a lunch of 922 calories.
Rafinirani ugljikohidrati, poput bijelog hljeba i tjestenine, izazivaju veće skokove šećera u krvi.
Refined carbohydrates, like white bread and pasta, cause bigger spikes in blood sugar.
Popodne tijelo i slabije obrađuje glukozu, pa takav ručak dodatno smanjuje energiju.
In the afternoon the body also processes glucose less efficiently, so such a lunch reduces energy even more.
Savjet je da ugljikohidrate kombinujete sa zdravim mastima, na primjer s kriškama avokada.
The advice is to combine carbohydrates with healthy fats, for example with slices of avocado.
Tanjir treba sadržavati nemasno meso, povrće, mahunarke i integralne žitarice.
The plate should contain lean meat, vegetables, legumes and whole grains.
Za mnoge odrasle dobar početak je ručak od 400 do 600 kalorija, a ne 900 ili više.
For many adults a good start is a lunch of 400 to 600 calories, not 900 or more.

title: Zmajevima treba jedna pobjeda do baraža za Ligu A
The Dragons need one win to reach the play-off for League A
body: Selektor Sergej Barbarez danas u 11 sati izlazi pred novinare u prostorijama Nogometnog saveza BiH.
Selector Sergej Barbarez will appear before the press today at 11:00 at the premises of the Football Association of BiH.
Time počinje posljednje okupljanje reprezentacije u ovoj godini.
With this the national team's last gathering this year begins.
Spisak igrača već je objavljen na stranici saveza.
The list of players has already been published on the association's website.
Zmajevi igraju posljednja dva kola Lige nacija.
The Dragons play the last two rounds of the Nations League.
U subotu, 14. novembra, igraju protiv Švedske u Stockholmu, a 17. novembra primaju Rumuniju na Bilinom polju u Zenici.
On Saturday, 14 November, they play against Sweden in Stockholm, and on 17 November they host Romania at Bilino polje in Zenica.
Igrači će se okupiti u Sarajevu, gdje će trenirati na Grbavici i Koševu.
The players will gather in Sarajevo, where they will train at Grbavica and Koševo.
U grupi Švedska ima 10 bodova, BiH 8, Poljska 4, a Rumunija nijedan.
In the group Sweden has 10 points, BiH 8, Poland 4 and Romania none.
Jedna pobjeda u posljednja dva meča donosi drugo mjesto i baraž za Ligu A u martu 2027.
One win in the last two matches brings second place and a play-off for League A in March 2027.
Ako BiH dobije oba meča, plasirat će se direktno u Ligu A.
If BiH wins both matches, it will go up directly to League A.
Jedini konkurent za drugo mjesto je Poljska.
The only rival for second place is Poland.

title: U RS-u počinju trodnevni pregovori o minimalnoj plati
Three-day talks about the minimum wage begin in RS
body: Vlada Republike Srpske danas počinje trodnevne razgovore o minimalnoj plati.
The Government of Republika Srpska begins three days of talks about the minimum wage today.
Premijer Savo Minić rekao je da će se sastajati sa sindikatima i poslodavcima danas, sutra i u srijedu.
Prime Minister Savo Minić said he will meet with unions and employers today, tomorrow and on Wednesday.
Vlada želi da se do rješenja dođe dogovorom, a ne jednostranom odlukom.
The government wants a solution to be reached by agreement, not by a one-sided decision.
Na sastanku Ekonomsko-socijalnog vijeća 2. novembra svi su se složili da plata mora rasti ove godine, ali ne i za koliko.
At the Economic and Social Council meeting on 2 November everyone agreed that the wage must rise this year, but not by how much.
Poslodavci traže da povećanje prati makroekonomske pokazatelje i da se razlika nadoknadi nižim porezima.
Employers want the increase to follow macroeconomic indicators and the difference to be covered by lower taxes.
Sindikat poručuje da radnici očekuju veću platu kako bi kvalitetnije živjeli.
The union says workers expect a higher wage so that they can live better.
Danas osnovna minimalna plata iznosi 1.000 KM, a za više kvalifikacije do 1.450 KM.
Today the basic minimum wage is 1,000 KM, and for higher qualifications up to 1,450 KM.
Prosječna neto plata u RS-u u septembru bila je 1.727 KM.
The average net wage in RS in September was 1,727 KM.
Osnovna minimalna plata je oko 58 posto prosječne.
The basic minimum wage is about 58 percent of the average.
Prije pet godina minimalac je iznosio samo 520 KM.
Five years ago the minimum wage was only 520 KM.
Minić je naglasio da sindikati i poslodavci moraju donijeti stvarne podatke.
Minić stressed that unions and employers must bring real data.

title: Preminuo napadač iz Krakowa koji je ubio šest ljudi
The attacker from Kraków who killed six people has died
body: Napadač koji je u subotu na glavnom trgu u Krakowu ubio šest ljudi preminuo je u bolnici.
The attacker who on Saturday killed six people on the main square in Kraków has died in hospital.
To je jutros objavila policija regije Malopolska na društvenoj mreži X.
The police of the Lesser Poland region announced this this morning on the social network X.
Riječ je o 24-godišnjem muškarcu iz grada Ostrowiec Swietokrzyski.
He is a 24-year-old man from the town of Ostrowiec Swietokrzyski.
Napad se dogodio u subotu oko 15:00, kada je vozilom stigao na trg i pucao na slučajne prolaznike.
The attack happened on Saturday around 15:00, when he arrived at the square by car and shot at random passers-by.
Poginule su četiri žene i dva muškarca, među njima i jedan Britanac i jedna Austrijanka.
Four women and two men were killed, among them a British man and an Austrian woman.
Petnaest osoba je ranjeno.
Fifteen people were wounded.
Policija ga je zaustavila u pokušaju bijega, a u razmjeni vatre ranjena su i dva policajca.
Police stopped him as he tried to flee, and two officers were wounded in the exchange of fire.
Napadač je poslije hapšenja više puta operisan, ali je stanje bilo kritično.
After the arrest the attacker had several operations, but his condition was critical.
Tužilaštvo je u nedjelju otvorilo istragu i slučaj tretira kao teroristički čin.
The prosecutor's office opened an investigation on Sunday and treats the case as a terrorist act.
Vlasti su ranije rekle da je imao ultranacionalističke stavove.
Authorities said earlier that he held ultranationalist views.
Poljska je proglasila dva dana nacionalne žalosti.
Poland has declared two days of national mourning.

title: Preminuo Dževad Prekazi, legenda Partizana i Galatasaraya
Dževad Prekazi, a legend of Partizan and Galatasaray, has died
body: Nekadašnji fudbaler Dževad Prekazi preminuo je u 70. godini.
Former footballer Dževad Prekazi has died at the age of 70.
Vijest je u nedjelju potvrdio beogradski Partizan, koji se od njega oprostio emotivnom porukom.
The news was confirmed on Sunday by Belgrade's Partizan, which said goodbye to him with an emotional message.
Rođen je 18. augusta 1957. u Kosovskoj Mitrovici.
He was born on 18 August 1957 in Kosovska Mitrovica.
U Partizanu je prošao kroz omladinski pogon, a za prvi tim igrao je od 1976. do 1983.
At Partizan he went through the youth system, and he played for the first team from 1976 to 1983.
Prema podacima kluba, odigrao je 175 utakmica i postigao 23 gola.
According to the club's data, he played 175 matches and scored 23 goals.
Osvojio je tri titule prvaka Jugoslavije i Mitropa kup 1978.
He won three Yugoslav league titles and the Mitropa Cup in 1978.
Poslije sukoba s upravom Partizana prešao je u Hajduk, s kojim je osvojio Kup Jugoslavije.
After a dispute with Partizan's management he moved to Hajduk, with whom he won the Yugoslav Cup.
Godine 1985. otišao je u Galatasaray, gdje je proveo šest sezona.
In 1985 he went to Galatasaray, where he spent six seasons.
Tamo je osvojio dva naslova prvaka Turske, a navijači su ga zvali „Cevad“.
There he won two Turkish league titles, and fans called him “Cevad”.
Kasnije je trenirao Železnik i radio s mladim igračima u OFK Beogradu i Partizanu.
Later he coached Železnik and worked with young players at OFK Beograd and Partizan.
U intervjuu iz 2017. rekao je da želi biti sahranjen u crno-bijelom dresu Partizana.
In an interview in 2017 he said he wanted to be buried in the black-and-white Partizan jersey.

title: Farmeri u BiH ne mogu izvoziti meso, a uvoz raste
Farmers in BiH cannot export meat, while imports are growing
body: Domaći stočari u Bosni i Hercegovini kažu da su u začaranom krugu.
Domestic livestock farmers in Bosnia and Herzegovina say they are in a vicious circle.
Meso ne mogu izvoziti u Evropsku uniju, a na svom tržištu sve teže konkurišu uvozu.
They cannot export meat to the European Union, and on their own market it is getting harder to compete with imports.
Miljan Erbez iz udruženja proizvođača kaže da BiH više od tri decenije poslije rata nema mehanizme za ispunjavanje evropskih standarda.
Miljan Erbez from the producers' association says that more than three decades after the war BiH has no mechanisms to meet European standards.
Prošle godine BiH je izvezla meso i mesne prerađevine vrijedne 140,25 miliona KM, što je 3,09 posto manje nego ranije.
Last year BiH exported meat and meat products worth 140.25 million KM, which is 3.09 percent less than before.
Uvoz je istovremeno porastao za 3,56 posto i iznosio je 719,84 miliona KM.
At the same time imports grew by 3.56 percent and reached 719.84 million KM.
Izvoz, dakle, pokriva samo 19,48 posto uvoza.
So exports cover only 19.48 percent of imports.
Posebno je rastao uvoz smrznutog goveđeg mesa, i to za više od 80 posto.
Imports of frozen beef grew especially, by more than 80 percent.
Udruženje kaže da u zemlji ne radi sistem za označavanje i praćenje stoke.
The association says the system for marking and tracking cattle does not work in the country.
Zato se mnoge firme boje da će izgubiti i tradicionalna tržišta, posebno hrvatsko.
That is why many firms fear they will lose traditional markets too, especially the Croatian one.
Mljekari su u lošoj situaciji jer je otkupna cijena mlijeka pala i do 30 posto.
Dairy farmers are in a bad situation because the purchase price of milk has fallen by up to 30 percent.
Prema njihovom izračunu, jedna krava donosi 634 KM gubitka godišnje.
According to their calculation, one cow brings a loss of 634 KM per year.

title: Cijena nafte stabilna nakon velikog sedmičnog pada
The oil price is stable after a big weekly drop
body: Svjetske cijene nafte u ponedjeljak ujutro gotovo se nisu promijenile.
World oil prices hardly changed on Monday morning.
Brent nafta porasla je za 3 centa na 98,35 dolara za barel, javlja agencija Reuters.
Brent crude rose by 3 cents to 98.35 dollars a barrel, the Reuters agency reports.
Američka nafta WTI porasla je za 0,5 posto, na 91,30 dolara.
American WTI crude rose by 0.5 percent, to 91.30 dollars.
Na otvaranju tržišta cijena je pala za 64 centa, a u jednom trenutku čak za više od jednog dolara.
When the market opened, the price fell by 64 cents, and at one moment by more than one dollar.
Prošle sedmice Brent je pao za 16 posto, što je najveći sedmični pad od početka pandemije 2020. godine.
Last week Brent fell by 16 percent, which is the biggest weekly drop since the start of the pandemic in 2020.
Cijene su pale jer se nada da bi razgovori SAD-a i Irana mogli smanjiti opasnost za snabdijevanje kroz Hormuški moreuz.
Prices fell because there is hope that talks between the USA and Iran could reduce the danger for supply through the Strait of Hormuz.
Uprkos padu, nafta je i dalje oko 54 posto skuplja nego prije godinu dana.
Despite the drop, oil is still about 54 percent more expensive than a year ago.
Banka JPMorgan procjenjuje da je svjetski višak nafte u oktobru porastao na 1,4 miliona barela dnevno.
The bank JPMorgan estimates that the world oil surplus rose to 1.4 million barrels a day in October.
Razlozi su oporavak ponude na Bliskom istoku, veća proizvodnja u drugim zemljama i slaba potražnja.
The reasons are the recovery of supply in the Middle East, higher production in other countries and weak demand.

title: Danas oblačno, kiša u Hercegovini i dijelu Bosne
Cloudy today, rain in Herzegovina and part of Bosnia
body: Danas će u Bosni i Hercegovini biti pretežno oblačno, javlja Federalni hidrometeorološki zavod.
Today it will be mostly cloudy in Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Federal Hydrometeorological Institute reports.
Kiša se očekuje uglavnom u prvom dijelu dana, i to u Hercegovini, istočnoj Bosni i dijelu središnje Bosne.
Rain is expected mainly in the first part of the day, in Herzegovina, eastern Bosnia and part of central Bosnia.
Vjetar će biti slab, sa zapada ili sjeverozapada.
The wind will be weak, from the west or northwest.
Jutarnja temperatura bit će od 3 do 9 stepeni, a na jugu do 13.
Morning temperature will be from 3 to 9 degrees, and in the south up to 13.
Tokom dana bit će od 9 do 15 stepeni, a na jugu do 19.
During the day it will be from 9 to 15 degrees, and in the south up to 19.
U Sarajevu će biti umjereno do pretežno oblačno, uz povremenu slabu kišu.
In Sarajevo it will be moderately to mostly cloudy, with occasional light rain.
Ujutro će biti oko 5 stepeni, a popodne oko 13.
In the morning it will be about 5 degrees, and in the afternoon about 13.
U utorak se očekuje oblačno vrijeme s kišom, koja će biti najjača poslijepodne i u noći.
On Tuesday cloudy weather with rain is expected, which will be strongest in the afternoon and at night.
Kiša nastavlja i u srijedu, uz temperature do 16 stepeni, a na jugu do 18.
The rain continues on Wednesday, with temperatures up to 16 degrees, and in the south up to 18.
U četvrtak će biti najtoplije, do 23 stepeni, uz umjeren do jak jugozapadni vjetar.
On Thursday it will be the warmest, up to 23 degrees, with a moderate to strong southwest wind.

title: Dokumentarac o Elizabeth Holmes zaradio 80 miliona dolara
Documentary about Elizabeth Holmes has earned 80 million dollars
body: Film „You Can See Everything“ postao je drugi najunosniji dokumentarac u historiji Sjeverne Amerike, ne računajući muzičke filmove.
The film “You Can See Everything” has become the second highest-grossing documentary in North American history, not counting music films.
Poslije četiri vikenda u kinima zaradio je 80 miliona dolara, piše Variety.
After four weekends in cinemas it has earned 80 million dollars, Variety writes.
Film su režirali Nathan Fielder i Lance Oppenheim, a govori o Elizabeth Holmes, osnivačici firme Theranos.
The film was directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim, and it is about Elizabeth Holmes, the founder of the company Theranos.
Prošlog vikenda film je zaradio 8,8 miliona dolara u 2.473 kina, što je 23 posto manje nego prethodnog vikenda.
Last weekend the film earned 8.8 million dollars in 2,473 cinemas, which is 23 percent less than the weekend before.
Tako je prestigao film „Marš pingvina“ iz 2005. godine, koji je zaradio 77 miliona.
With that it passed the film “March of the Penguins” from 2005, which earned 77 million.
Ispred njega je još samo „Fahrenheit 9/11“ Michaela Moorea sa 119 miliona dolara.
Ahead of it is only Michael Moore's “Fahrenheit 9/11” with 119 million dollars.
Film košta samo 7 miliona dolara, pa će biti vrlo isplativ.
The film cost only 7 million dollars, so it will be very profitable.
Analitičar Paul Dergarabedian rekao je da je film promijenio pravila o tome kako dokumentarac može proći u kinima.
Analyst Paul Dergarabedian said that the film has changed the rules about how a documentary can do in cinemas.
Premijera je bila na festivalu u Tellurideu, a prvog vikenda film je zaradio 15 miliona dolara.
The premiere was at the festival in Telluride, and on the first weekend the film earned 15 million dollars.
Mnogi gledaoci vratili su se da ga gledaju ponovo, iako traje skoro tri sata.
Many viewers came back to watch it again, even though it lasts almost three hours.
Izvan Sjeverne Amerike film će se prikazivati od kraja novembra.
Outside North America the film will be shown from the end of November.

title: Pobuna u SDS-u: još jedan član traži Blanušin odlazak
Revolt in SDS: another member demands Blanuša’s departure
body: U stranci SDS nastavlja se otvorena pobuna protiv predsjednika Branka Blanuše nakon izbora.
In the SDS party the open revolt against president Branko Blanuša continues after the elections.
Član Glavnog odbora Daniel Jakovljević objavio je dugu poruku na Facebooku.
Main Board member Daniel Jakovljević published a long message on Facebook.
U njoj je napisao da Blanuša više ne može biti predsjednik jer je izgubio povjerenje članova i birača.
In it he wrote that Blanuša can no longer be president because he has lost the trust of members and voters.
Jakovljević kaže da je oko šest sedmica šutio i da je kolege molio da probleme iznesu u tijelima stranke, koja se ne sazivaju.
Jakovljević says he was silent for about six weeks and asked colleagues to raise the problems in party bodies, which are not being convened.
Smatra da je velika greška što SDS nije prihvatio prijedlog da članovi PSS-a kolektivno pristupe stranci.
He thinks it is a big mistake that SDS did not accept the proposal that PSS members join the party collectively.
Po njegovom mišljenju, SDS bi tada imao oko 30 poslanika, a Stanivuković bi pobijedio na izborima za predsjednika Republike Srpske.
In his opinion, SDS would then have about 30 MPs, and Stanivuković would have won the election for president of Republika Srpska.
Želi da stranku ponovo vodi Milan Milićević, kojeg naziva patriotom i kaže da je nepravedno uklonjen prije izbora.
He wants Milan Milićević to lead the party again; he calls him a patriot and says he was unfairly removed before the elections.
Ljubiša Petrović, isključen iz stranke jer je podržao kandidata druge stranke, uložio je žalbu Glavnom odboru.
Ljubiša Petrović, expelled from the party because he supported another party’s candidate, has appealed to the Main Board.
Blanuša je 2. novembra rekao da neće podnijeti ostavku, jer bi to produbilo krizu.
On 2 November Blanuša said he will not resign, because that would deepen the crisis.
Jakovljević najavljuje da će na sljedećoj sjednici glasati za Petrovićev povratak, ali datum sjednice nije poznat.
Jakovljević announces that he will vote for Petrović’s return at the next session, but the date of the session is not known.

title: Rukometaši BiH teško poraženi od Češke u Tuzli
Handball players of BiH heavily beaten by the Czech Republic in Tuzla
body: Rukometaši Bosne i Hercegovine izgubili su u Tuzli od Češke 19:32 u kvalifikacijama za Evropsko prvenstvo 2028.
The handball players of Bosnia and Herzegovina lost 19:32 to the Czech Republic in Tuzla in qualifiers for the 2028 European Championship.
Utakmica je igrana u dvorani Mejdan, a BiH je poveo već u prvoj minuti golom Mehmedovića.
The match was played in the Mejdan hall, and BiH took the lead in the very first minute with a goal by Mehmedović.
To je, ipak, bilo jedino vodstvo domaćina.
That was, however, the only lead of the hosts.
Česi su brzo preuzeli kontrolu i poslije 12 minuta vodili su 7:1.
The Czechs quickly took control and after 12 minutes they led 7:1.
Trener Damir Doborac je do 20. minute potrošio oba tajm-auta, ali to nije pomoglo.
Coach Damir Doborac used both timeouts by the 20th minute, but that did not help.
Šoljić i Faljić dobili su po dvije isključenja, pa je BiH u jednom trenutku igrala sa dva igrača manje.
Šoljić and Faljić each got two suspensions, so at one point BiH played with two players fewer.
Poluvrijeme je završilo rezultatom 13:7 za goste.
The first half ended 13:7 for the guests.
U drugom dijelu Šahinović je s linije sedmeraca držao BiH u igri, a golman Brkić odbranio je dva sedmerca.
In the second half Šahinović kept BiH in the game from the seven-metre line, and goalkeeper Brkić saved two seven-metre throws.
Šest minuta prije kraja razlika je bila 14 golova.
Six minutes before the end the gap was 14 goals.
BiH je to drugi poraz u kvalifikacijama, jer je u prvom kolu izgubila od Slovenije 38:28 u Kopru.
This is BiH's second defeat in the qualifiers, because in the first round it lost to Slovenia 38:28 in Koper.
Ona je jedina ekipa u grupi 5 koja još nema bodova, dok Češka ima četiri.
It is the only team in group 5 that still has no points, while the Czech Republic has four.
Kvalifikacije se nastavljaju u martu 2027. s dvije utakmice protiv Izraela, a u maju BiH dočekuje Sloveniju.
The qualifiers continue in March 2027 with two matches against Israel, and in May BiH hosts Slovenia.

title: Gradonačelnik pokušao uručiti tužbu iranskom diplomati
Mayor tried to hand a lawsuit to an Iranian diplomat
body: Gradonačelnik izraelskog grada Bat Jam, Cvika Brot, pokušao je prošle sedmice u New Yorku uručiti tužbu iranskom diplomati.
The mayor of the Israeli city of Bat Yam, Tzvika Brot, tried last week in New York to hand a lawsuit to an Iranian diplomat.
Radi se o prvom sekretaru iranske misije pri Ujedinjenim nacijama.
He is the first secretary of Iran’s mission to the United Nations.
Brot mu je prišao na pješačkom prelazu i rekao na engleskom da je gradonačelnik i da je dokument tužba protiv njegove države.
Brot approached him at a crosswalk and said in English that he was the mayor and that the document was a lawsuit against his country.
Diplomata je odgovorio da je diplomata i da mu je žao, a zatim je otišao.
The diplomat answered that he was a diplomat and that he was sorry, and then he walked away.
Brot ga je pratio i zamolio da tužbu smatra službeno uručenom njegovoj vladi.
Brot followed him and asked him to consider the lawsuit officially served to his government.
Grad je podnio tužbu protiv Irana na sudu u Tel Avivu i traži 208 miliona šekela, oko 65 miliona dolara.
The city has filed a lawsuit against Iran in a court in Tel Aviv and demands 208 million shekels, about 65 million dollars.
Tužba se odnosi na iranski raketni napad od 15. juna 2025. koji je pogodio stambenu zgradu.
The lawsuit refers to the Iranian missile attack of 15 June 2025, which hit a residential building.
U tom napadu poginulo je devet civila, a skoro 200 ljudi je povrijeđeno.
In that attack nine civilians were killed and almost 200 people were injured.
Priprema akcije trajala je četiri mjeseca, a prema izraelskim medijima u njoj su učestvovali i izraelski i američki zvaničnici.
The preparation of the action took four months, and according to Israeli media both Israeli and American officials took part.
Prema izraelskom zakonu, tuženi mora biti obaviješten o tužbi prije nego što postupak počne.
According to Israeli law, the defendant must be notified of the lawsuit before the proceedings can begin.

title: Tabaković postigao osmi gol sezone za Salzburg
Tabaković scores his eighth goal of the season for Salzburg
body: Bosanski napadač Haris Tabaković i u nedjelju je zatresao mrežu u austrijskoj Bundesligi.
Bosnian striker Haris Tabaković shook the net again on Sunday in the Austrian Bundesliga.
Igrao je za Red Bull Salzburg protiv Sturma u 12. kolu.
He played for Red Bull Salzburg against Sturm in round 12.
Gol je postigao već u 5. minuti i tako je Salzburgu donio vodstvo.
He scored already in the 5th minute and so gave Salzburg the lead.
Asistent je bio Mazurek.
The assist came from Mazurek.
To je Tabakovićev osmi gol u ovoj sezoni.
It is Tabaković’s eighth goal this season.
Zahvaljujući tome, nalazi se na drugom mjestu liste strijelaca u austrijskoj ligi.
Thanks to that, he is in second place on the scorers’ list in the Austrian league.
Klix u tekstu ne navodi konačan rezultat utakmice.
In the text Klix does not give the final score of the match.
Navodi samo da je Tabakovićev gol donio Salzburgu prednost.
It only says that Tabaković’s goal gave Salzburg an advantage.
Gol možete pogledati na videu koji je objavila televizija Sky Sport Austria.
You can watch the goal in a video published by the television channel Sky Sport Austria.

title: Bajraktarević za PSV upisao drugu asistenciju
Bajraktarević records his second assist for PSV
body: Bosanski reprezentativac Esmir Bajraktarević briljirao je u utakmici 12. kola holandske Eredivisie između Cambuura i PSV-a.
Bosnian international Esmir Bajraktarević shone in the round 12 match of the Dutch Eredivisie between Cambuur and PSV.
PSV je gostovao i nakon 19 minuta vodio je 3:0.
PSV was the away team and after 19 minutes led 3:0.
U 15. minuti drugi gol za goste postigao je Mijnans, a asistirao je Ruben van Bommel.
In the 15th minute Mijnans scored the second goal for the guests, and Ruben van Bommel assisted.
Već u 19. minuti treći gol dao je sam Van Bommel.
In the 19th minute Van Bommel himself scored the third goal.
Asistent je bio Bajraktarević, koji je lijepim driblingom prevario odbrambenog igrača i dodao loptu saigraču.
The assist came from Bajraktarević, who beat a defender with a nice dribble and passed the ball to a teammate.
Bilo je to njegovo drugo asistiranje u toj utakmici.
It was his second assist in that match.
Poslije 19. minute utakmica je prekinuta zbog sukoba navijača.
After the 19th minute the match was stopped because of clashes between fans.
U trenutku objave teksta igra još nije bila nastavljena.
At the time the text was published the game had not yet continued.
Klix ne navodi ko je postigao prvi gol za PSV.
Klix does not say who scored the first goal for PSV.

title: U Rajlovcu gore stari vagoni, niko nije ugrožen
Old wagons are burning in Rajlovac, nobody is in danger
body: U Sarajevu je u nedjelju izbio požar na starim vagonima na depou željezničke stanice u Rajlovcu.
On Sunday a fire broke out in Sarajevo on old wagons at the depot of the railway station in Rajlovac.
Čitaoci su Klixu poslali fotografije i video snimke na kojima se vidi veliki plamen i gust crni dim iznad vagona.
Readers sent Klix photos and videos showing a big flame and thick black smoke above the wagons.
Iz Kantonalne profesionalne vatrogasne jedinice potvrdili su da su na terenu nekoliko ekipa.
The Cantonal Professional Fire Brigade confirmed that several crews are on the scene.
Vagoni su stari i napušteni, pa vatra ne prijeti ni ljudima ni privatnoj imovini.
The wagons are old and abandoned, so the fire threatens neither people nor private property.
Vatrogasci su požar brzo ograničili da se ne bi proširio, a sada ga gase do kraja.
Firefighters quickly limited the fire so it would not spread, and now they are putting it out completely.
Nema podataka o povrijeđenima niti o šteti.
There is no information about injured people or about damage.
Uzrok požara za sada nije poznat.
The cause of the fire is not known for now.
Kada se vatra ugasi, policija će izvršiti uviđaj na licu mjesta.
When the fire is out, the police will carry out an on-site investigation.
Tada bi trebalo biti jasno je li požar podmetnut, a ako jest, ko je za to odgovoran.
Then it should become clear whether the fire was set on purpose and, if so, who is responsible.

title: Serija „Taken“ na vrhu Netflixa: priča o nestaloj tinejdžerki
Series “Taken” tops Netflix: the story of a missing teenager
body: Dokumentarna mini-serija „Taken: Natalee Holloway“ trenutno je na prvom mjestu gledanosti na Netflixu.
The documentary mini-series “Taken: Natalee Holloway” is currently first in viewership on Netflix.
Na platformi je od 4. novembra, a prema stranici FlixPatrol prva je među serijama od 7. novembra, sa 707 bodova.
It has been on the platform since 4 November, and according to the site FlixPatrol it has been first among series since 7 November, with 707 points.
Ima tri epizode, svaka traje od 30 do 45 minuta, a režirali su je Dani Sloane i Matthew Galkin.
It has three episodes, each lasting 30 to 45 minutes, and it was directed by Dani Sloane and Matthew Galkin.
Serija govori o Natalee Holloway, koja je nestala 30. maja 2005. na maturalnom putovanju na Arubi.
The series is about Natalee Holloway, who disappeared on 30 May 2005 on a graduation trip to Aruba.
Imala je 18 godina, a posljednji put viđena je kada je izlazila iz bara s Holanđaninom Joranom van der Sloot.
She was 18 years old, and she was last seen leaving a bar with the Dutchman Joran van der Sloot.
Priča je ispričana uglavnom iz ugla njene majke Beth, a ima i ranije neobjavljenih snimaka razgovora s istražiteljima.
The story is told mainly from the point of view of her mother Beth, and it also includes previously unpublished recordings of conversations with investigators.
Kritičari nisu jedinstveni.
Critics are not united.
Neki kažu da serija ne donosi mnogo novog onima koji su pratili slučaj, ali dobro prikazuje šta su prošle majka i prijatelji.
Some say the series does not bring much new to those who followed the case, but shows well what the mother and friends went through.
Drugi je kritikuju zbog kratkih epizoda, jer smatraju da bi dugometražni film bolje ispričao priču.
Others criticise it for the short episodes, because they think a feature-length film would tell the story better.

title: NASA izabrala osam firmi za dostave na Mjesec
NASA chose eight companies for deliveries to the Moon
body: Američka svemirska agencija NASA izabrala je osam kompanija koje će dostavljati teret na Mjesec.
The American space agency NASA chose eight companies that will deliver cargo to the Moon.
To su SpaceX, Blue Origin, Firefly Aerospace, Intuitive Machines, iSpace US, Lockheed Martin Space, Northrop Grumman Space Systems i Voyager Technologies.
They are SpaceX, Blue Origin, Firefly Aerospace, Intuitive Machines, iSpace US, Lockheed Martin Space, Northrop Grumman Space Systems and Voyager Technologies.
Odluka je objavljena u subotu na sajmu na svemirskom centru Kennedy na Floridi.
The decision was announced on Saturday at a fair at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Ugovor vrijedi do 10 milijardi dolara u narednih 10 godina.
The contract is worth up to 10 billion dollars over the next 10 years.
To je gornja granica za buduće misije, a ne novac koji je već dodijeljen, jer će se firme takmičiti za svaku pojedinačnu dostavu.
This is an upper limit for future missions, not money that has already been awarded, because the companies will compete for each individual delivery.
Granica trenutnog ugovora povećana je s 2,6 na 4,2 milijarde dolara.
The limit of the current contract was raised from 2.6 to 4.2 billion dollars.
Blue Origin je dobio 94 miliona dolara za robotsko vozilo PROMISE, koje će raditi i tokom duge mjesečeve noći.
Blue Origin received 94 million dollars for the PROMISE rover, which will work even during the long lunar night.
Lansiranje je planirano krajem 2028.
The launch is planned for the end of 2028.
Cilj je stalna baza na južnom polu Mjeseca.
The goal is a permanent base at the Moon’s south pole.
Šef NASA-e Jared Isaacman rekao je da grade bazu na Mjesecu misiju po misiju.
NASA chief Jared Isaacman said that they are building a base on the Moon mission by mission.
SpaceX će 2028. raketom Starship lansirati i komunikacijske satelite.
In 2028 SpaceX will also launch communication satellites with its Starship rocket.
